reviews.author: Lisa

reviews.text:
We’ve dined here at least half a dozen times, and the food and cocktails have always been exceptional. The service has consistently been outstanding as well.

The only reason I’m giving 3 stars for service on this visit is because of our server. The rest of the staff was excellent and absolutely deserves 5 stars.

Our server was friendly, but she did not provide the level of service we’ve come to expect from Wolf. She appeared to need much more training and experience to meet the restaurant’s otherwise high standards.

This experience won’t keep us from returning. We look forward to dining here again soon.

reviews.text:
Really enjoyed our girls night out. We chose to eat here and the food was amazing. It was extremely busy, but service was wonderful!
￼ The restaurant is absolutely gorgeous inside!

reviews.text: We had the worst meal! The apps were great but my steak was cold and my husband had a beef pasta and he couldn’t separate the beef “brisket” if that’s what they want to call it.  It was like they gave him a big piece of a nasty tendon and he couldn’t even separate it, it was one big nasty lump of inedible meat.  No one asked how we liked our food.  It was not an enjoyable experience.

reviews.text: Parker and Emily took great care of us, the food and service was so amazing and attentive!!! Can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Nick

reviews.text:
Overall experience was great of service and drinks / presentation was phenomenal.

As for the food I am extremely disappointed. Chilean sea bass, salmon and goat cheese balls were really good. Tuna tartare was ceviche on a chip with tajin and should not be called tartare.

The part that got me to write this review was the ribeye. A $90 ribeye that may have been the worst ribeye I have ever had. Comes out pre cut covered in thick chimichurri that looks like pesto so you can’t even see the steak as if they were trying to hide it. Once getting into it the steak it was chewy rubbery fat that was way too undercooked to be called medium rare. You would think if they’re cutting the steak for you they would notice that it is undercooked. Very disappointed the worst steak i’ve ever had, i’m sure a sale ribeye from fry’s would taste just the same if you slopped some chimichurri all over it.

I’m sure the filet is good but as for the ribeye do not order. Might as well take that off the menu until you find a better cut steak and I wouldn’t be here writing this review.

reviews.text: Amazing experience! Came back a second time and everything was delicious, the energy and vibe is so fun and really made my fiancés birthday off to a fun start. The staff is so attentive and friendly, and I would highly recommend for a special occasion!
reviews.author: Gilbert

reviews.text: Everything was really amazing! I would definitely recommend for food, waitress, bussers, ambiance. However. The hostess was so rude, very disrespectful. Considering these are the first employees to interact with as you check in and wait for your table, it is enough to never return. One of the girls was extremely rude, inconsiderate and very disrespectful.
reviews.author: Shadi

reviews.text: We very much enjoyed the ambiance, the menu, food and service were excellent. We dined Friday night and after music started found it to be quite noisy.
reviews.author: Carl

reviews.text: Overall, the food was good but nothing exceptional.  While the staff itself was great and attentive, our individual server fell short.  She knew it was our first time and rather than introducing herself and making menu suggestions we were greeted with "Are you ready to order".  When placing our entrees, which we decided to do family and style and informed her of this, the steak still did not come out sliced and ready to serve.  It's the little things that leave an impression. When there all multiple glasses of wine offered under the same label, the server should have asked for clarification vs assuming the most expensive glass was the one requested. Lesson learned. In a city like Scottsdale it's going to take more than the name to stay on top.  In my opinion service should be held to the highest of standards for a restaurant such as this.
reviews.author: joy

reviews.text: This is our second and last visit to Wolf. The noise level is excessive and impedes our ability to enjoy conversation and a meal together. We waited excessively long between courses, despite the fact that it was not particularly busy during our visit. Additionally, for this price point, I should not be expected to box my leftovers up myself. Ridiculous!

reviews.text: The atmosphere and service are excellent, but the food and drinks are excessively expensive. The food was decent, but not worth the high prices. reviews.text: Wolf lived up to the Vanderpump standards! I've been dying to go to any of LVP restaurants and was so excited to hear about Wolf Scottsdale. Sometimes I feel with iconic spots like this, the vibes are better than the food, but the vibes matched the food at Wolf! Every detail, down to the gold flakes on the wings or the presentation of the goat cheeseballs, was immaculate. I ordered the goat cheeseballs, the everything bagel martini, and the steak - highly recommend all 3! Others in our group enjoyed the wings, the bolognese, and the salmon.

Highly recommended.

reviews.text: The restaurant is beautifully decorated but  the drink. Prices are a little high! The food was OK. However, the noise level was ridiculous. We had to yell to talk to one another. I don't think I will dine there again.

reviews.text: My meal was over-salted. We aren’t the kind of people to say something to disturb a meal. But the top crust on the salmon was inedible because of the salt. Service was fantastic.
reviews.author: Adrienne

reviews.text: WOLF by Vanderpump was truly an out-of-this-world dining experience. Every detail felt elevated from start to finish — the caviar, iconic goat cheese balls, and warm Wolf Bread were the perfect way to begin the night. The filet mignon was cooked flawlessly, the sea bass was incredible, and ending with cobbler and an espresso martini made the entire experience feel indulgent in the best way. The atmosphere, cocktails, and presentation all delivered that glamorous signature Vanderpump vibe. ✨🍸
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We chose Wolf to celebrate our son’s 21st birthday. Everyone was lovely and we were met with wonderful service. The food was good with filling portions. The shrimp tacos were incredibly flavor-filled! I do wish we could have been seated closer to the west wall to see the sunset (there were empty tables). They knew we were celebrating an event and I thought they would do what they could to make it as memorable as possible. I didn’t ask because I didn’t realize the tables were empty until the waters came. I might choose another venue for celebrations in the future, but we enjoyed the experience overall.

reviews.text: I brought my wife and her sister for their birthdays and it was outstanding. The service was amazing, they were on top of our every need! They even brought us birthday shots specialized to the drinks each of us ordered as well as birthday dessert! My wife loved the pumptini, and the goat cheese balls were out of this world! I got the fish and chips and it was a large portion, great for the value! My sister in law had the filet and it was cooked perfectly! The atmosphere is indescribable like no where I have been before. Truly amazing, cannot wait to be back for drinks and goat cheese balls!

reviews.text: This was our second visit.  Started with not getting the seating we had requested. Then the basketball game was on and it was more like a sports bar than the intimate high end vibe we experienced the first time. Food options are creative however everything is either fried or saturated in butter. Appetizers were good however it is always frustrating when they serve three portions when there is typically 2 to 4 guests. Salads are very large portions and it would have been good if the server had mentioned that as we would have split a salad. Overall I probably wouldn’t come back except to maybe have drinks at the bar.

The table itself was also small it was hard for myself and my friend to fit our two waters two cocktails, two entrees, and sides we ordered all on the table. reviews.text: Good dinner, would not go back as a choice of mine.  They rushed us in and out with in an hour on our anniversary dinner.  We ordered apps and entrees because they were going to be coursed out and they came within 5 min of each other.  Bread was good but messy and all over the table.  Drinks took forever and were more for show that flavor.  It’s more of a restaurant “to be seen in for the gram” than an actually fine dining experiences. We changed the potatoes on the seabass for the yucca fries and they forgot them, and they were hard and dry.  May be good to go with friends and chill but not for a special occasion.  I would go back if I was invited but it would not be my 1st - 10th choice at all.  Food was ok, nothing special.  Service was ok, nothing special and the hotel charges you just to dine there.

reviews.text:
The food and the ambience were excellent.
While it was a bit noisy, most upscale restaurants are these days.
The area of disappointment was the service.
Generally, the food arrived promptly; however, there were two problems:
1.  The garlic potatoes (a part of the main course), were not served with the main course.  We had to remind the server that we had ordered them, and they finally arrived 15 minutes later.
2.  We had to continually remind the server and supporting staff to clear our dirty dishes from the table to make way for the next serving.  Unless we spoke up, they seemed content to let the dirty dishes pile up.

reviews.text: First, there was no parking, forcing us to use the $12 valet service. Despite making a standard reservation, we were seated at a small table where one of the seats was a backless stool.  I have a bad back and asked to be reseated or to have a chair instead but was told none were available.  I wish this would have been clear when I booked it.  When my entree (salmon) was delivered, it came by itself on a simple white plate - no side or garnish despite clearly saying on the menu that it came with potatoes and vegetables. When I asked, they did apologize and bring it fairly quickly.  The salmon was delicious but my wife got the filet and said it was a little dry.  Because of the side dish mistake they did bring us a free dessert. The atmosphere was great, fun and livley.
reviews.author: Stacy

reviews.text: We went for lunch and had an amazing time! The service and food were fantastic. The place is so fun and definitely worth the visit!
reviews.author: Lisa

reviews.text: The restaurant is beautiful. Service was outstanding.  Food was incredible.  Shrimp cocktail was like 4 little lobsters!!!  Ribeye was incredible.  Seabass amazing.  The only issue we had was them placing a BS Hotel Admin fee of 3.5% (came out to $10). There should not be any additional fees at restaurants especially "admin fee".  They say is the hotel but then that is between Wolf and the Hilton.   Still a great dinner and drinks night out.

reviews.text: What a disappointment. Food is awful. No other way to put it. I’ve been here for brunch, food was also terrible. The ambience is prettier at night time with all the lights on however the noise level of the music is as if you are at a nightclub in Las Vegas. Service was awful as well. ￼

reviews.text:
We went to celebrate our engagement anniversary and were excited to give the restaurant a try. We showed up early for our reservation, and they were quick to get us seated at a window table, which you would have thought would have been the best seat in the restaurant, except for the fact that the structural beams of the building were directly in eyesight of Camelback Mountain, so you couldn't actually even see the view. That was likely an oversight when the building was being erected, and that's not necessarily something that you can blame on the restaurant team. I do think potentially creating a platform with elevated tables would make sense so that the view was unobstructed. 

There were air conditioning vents on the ground adjacent to our table, and the draft was fairly heavy. The table next to us told us the solution is to put our dinner menu on top of the vents. When I looked at the other tables near us, everyone had done that. We followed suit. 

Our server greeted us, congratulating us on the celebration of our anniversary. From there, we ordered cocktails and placed a food order. There was no spiel. Our cocktails tasted fine. The one with cotton candy on it made the glass sticky, which then made my fiancé's hands sticky, which then made everything on the table sticky. The beet salad was just your general run-of-the-mill beet salad. The bread was good, especially with the truffle butter. The risotto was bland and tasted exclusively of the finely ground black pepper dust. The Filet and truffle fries were good.

They brought us a complimentary dessert, which was thoughtful, but we were never shown a dessert menu or offered coffee/after dinner drink. The gentleman who dropped our dessert at the table wished us a happy birthday (we were celebrating an anniversary).

Overall, we had fun, but it wasn't because the restaurant was exceptional. It's because we enjoyed each other's company and got a good laugh at the circumstance.

reviews.text:
We had a very disappointing experience at Wolf by Vanderpump during a birthday celebration this past Saturday.
Our reservation was at 2:30 PM. We were seated and ordered drinks and appetizers, but after the second round of drinks, service slowed down significantly. It took nearly two hours before we were able to order dinner. When the dinner orders finally arrived, they were incorrect.
Throughout the meal, our table was left with dirty appetizer plates and empty drink glasses. We spoke with a manager about the issues, but there was very little urgency or accountability. After almost four hours, we had enough and asked to speak with a higher-level manager. We were told the manager was “on the 8th floor,” which made it feel like no one truly wanted to address the situation.
The food portion of the bill was credited, but the overall experience was still extremely disappointing. For a restaurant connected to the Hilton Hotel Group and the Vanderpump name, we expected much better service, better management, and a much more professional guest experience.
Unfortunately, this was not the birthday celebration we had hoped for. Based on our visit, the restaurant appears poorly managed and lacking the level of service expected at this type of venue.

reviews.text: Too bad the food doesn’t match the amazing ambiance. Absolutely stunning place with great vibes and great cocktails but the food is equal to bar food at best. Will keep coming back but definitely not for the food unfortunately. Hope it gets better in time.
reviews.author: Angela

reviews.text:
The decor was second to none! Everywhere you looked, beauty and creativity was eminent, over exceeding my imagination creating a pleasant atmosphere. The views of the mountain and sunset were stellar!

All various staff from hostess, bar and waiter went above and beyond expectations. Pricing was what I would expect, similar to other places of the same caliber.

The food was delicious, we we prompted to add to our orders. I had the risotto and chicken, delicious. My only issue was that we couldn’t get separate checks for our table of 10 various ladies. It made it very difficult to figure out what everyone owed.  Never happy about the extra 3.5% fee added.

The live band in the roof was an added bonus.
I would go again but not in a large group unfortunately.
reviews.author: Mary

reviews.text:
Great food! The chicken is the best!  Gigi was an awesome server!  Thank you for the window table to celebrate a friend’s bday.
It was a little too warm in the restaurant…other than that, it was a perfect night!
reviews.author: Sarah

reviews.text: Everything was great!  Our server was attentive but not constantly at our table. The food was amazing!
reviews.author: Rachel

reviews.text: Great atmosphere, food and service the goat cheese balls are awesome. We had the ribeye, bolognese and sea bass. All were excellent.
reviews.author: David

reviews.text: Fun! Really enjoyed the vibes. Food was good. Good times.
reviews.author: Amanda

reviews.text: Average food over priced. Snooty hostesses friendly servers. Wouldn’t return.
reviews.author: Pamela

reviews.text: Ashton, server, was fantastic. Promote them as soon as possible.
reviews.author: Mack

reviews.text: Very beautiful staff went above and beyond. We also appreciated that our elderly dog was welcomed.
reviews.author: Ellen

reviews.text:
I wanted to absolutely love this place but it fell short.  Brought a group of 6 for dinner and we were seated outdoors which was per our request.  The table was abnormally uncomfortable with the chairs being so low it made eating a challenge.  We were between two pillars so the view wasn’t much other than seeing their swimming pool 10’ away.

The drinks were fabulous! Really fabulous! We could see going back for the cocktail experience however not the food.  The food was dry and not much more than elevated bar food.  Everything had a sauce with it and it needed sauce desperately!

Our server was lovely!  The space is beautiful and exceptionally well appointed.  So the consensus between all 6 of us was we would possibly go back for cocktails but wouldn’t make an evening of it.
reviews.author: Meshelle

reviews.text: Our server was excellent. The restaurant is eclectic and comfortable. Food was better than average, not exceptional. The restaurant was quite loud. Can’t recommend as a place to have quiet conversation, more of a “ social scene”.
reviews.author: Thomas

reviews.text: Great food and drinks, loved the views of Camelback...
reviews.author: Gabriel

reviews.text: Wonderful, best salad and steak I’ve had in a long time
reviews.author: Shannan

reviews.text: Amazing atmosphere and nice staff. GOAT cheese balls are always a must.
reviews.author: James

reviews.text: We highly recommend Wolf! I honestly cannot think of one thing that they could improve upon. I can’t wait to go back!
reviews.author: Paula

reviews.text:
Ambiance of restaurant was amazing, experience was not.
Although my server knew of my gluten allergy, my meal came out with a side which I didn’t think was GF. The chef came out & apologized, as he is usually made aware of all allergies. He redid my plate- what made me agitated was he came back and said it’s a good thing HE caught this- HE did not catch it - I did.
This left a poor taste in my mouth as they also did not try to rectify by offering an another side or a dessert or even comp a portion of the meal.
Very disappointed as was looking for the food to match the excellent views and beautiful decor of the restaurant.  The menu is marked however, if I did not catch the mistake could have led to very serious consequences.
For the price I can go to many other fine dining establishments in Scottsdale. ￼
reviews.author: Jennifer

reviews.text: The ambience was very good the food was OK and they added a service fee that they did not disclose previously. The service was marginal.
reviews.author: Lisa

reviews.text: Had to wait 45 minutes even with a reservation, they should have let us know before
reviews.author: maria

reviews.text:
Our server was really nice and knowledgeable but food execution was off.

Caesar salad was brought without the truffle croutons

Entrees were staggered out -  10 minutes between the first people served to the last so our food was cold when we began eating. 

Two people ordered the same entree but they came out at different times and one had mounds of meat and the other had barely any. When we brought it to their attention they brought the chef out to confront the issue which was wildly inappropriate and uncomfortable. He came out with his arms crossed and defensive. He should be back in the kitchen cooking the food to ensure entrees aren’t staggered out, not handling customer complaints!

We let the manager know and she brushed us off and said “I wasn’t told that” and walked away. 

Lisa vanderpump needs to get there to whip this crew in shape!
reviews.author: Alexa

reviews.text: This is an amazing experience! The food was excellent- so was the service. Thank you!
reviews.author: Robyn

reviews.text:
Booked this several weeks in advanced to celebrate 2 birthdays. Was disappointed that we had to wait 30 minutes to be seated past our reservation. only to be seated on a table just past the host stand with very obstructed views of the restaurant and city. The table was extremely small for 5 people. Our waitress was amazing and so nice but clearly she had too many tables to take care of at once resulting in slow service. Pricing was a bit high for certain items like the 6oz filet and the appetizers but kind of the norm in Scottsdale these days. 

Drinks were the best part and refreshing. Highly recommend if you like craft cocktails they have some unique drinks.
reviews.author: Caitlin

reviews.text: The atmosphere and vibe are very cool. The service was incredibly slow, took forever to receive food and drinks. Drinks were great and food was mediocre.
reviews.author: Jen

reviews.text: So it started out alittle rough.  We were given water and then no one cane to the table for about 20 minutes the busboy noticed and found someone.  The server John that came over was so apologetic friendly and fun.  He took our drink order and then the manager came over apologized and took care of our first round of drinks.  They went over and beyond to make sure the rest of our experience was awesome.  The food the service and the experience after the hiccup was memorable. Thank you John!
reviews.author: Mary

reviews.text: Amazing restaurant overall, but I felt bad for our server. He was doing a great job, just clearly stretched thin as the only one handling multiple tables. Because of that, food and drinks took a while. With a fuller staff that day, it easily would’ve been a 10/10 experience.
reviews.author: Alejandra

reviews.text: Wolf is a beautiful and elegant restaurant. We loved sitting outside and having the amazing DJ and pool view! 🩷 The Pumptini drink is everything and the food was incredible! 🙌 We loved everything LVP puts her hands on! 🩷🩷🩷
reviews.author: STEPHANIE

reviews.text: Celebrated my 40th birthday and it was an amazing experience! Decor is out of this world, drinks soooo good and food and appies spectacular sooo good! So happy we came
reviews.author: Dayna

reviews.text: Some of the food was good some was just really bad. The meat salad was tasteless and the cheese kind of taste tasted off. My daughter loved the filet mignon. The goat cheese balls were just OK not really a hot honey pop like we had hoped. We were sat outside next to the pool. The chairs are a lot lower than the table which came up to our chest, which made it very uncomfortable, and the chair padding was kind of wet and uncomfortable. I didn’t really enjoy sitting next to the pool when I chose outdoor seating. I didn’t understand that’s what that meant. We also had the crab appetizer which was mediocre at best.  My son loved the shrimp tacos.  The bread on the burger was kind of old tasting The weight staff was great and the service was excellent. The ambience inside was nice just kind of a bad birthday dinner which was a bummer because it’s something we look forward to for a long time.
reviews.author: Merrimentnchaos

reviews.text: Our server was great but the Food came out way too quickly and not spaced out. But then it took a long time to get our check. This is my second time and other than the Cesar salad, tuna appetizer, and the goat cheese balls, the food is lackluster.
reviews.author: Rachel

reviews.text: Absolutely a wonderful evening.  The atmosphere, wait staff and food was excellent.
reviews.author: Kristine

reviews.text: Amazing service, atmosphere and food!! We loved everything about our experience!
reviews.author: Tami

reviews.text: I was disappointed in lunch compared to our evening experience. I felt bad for the server as he was maintaining the pool area as well as the front of the house. Therefore, service was low do to the waiter being stretched too thin with the pool.
reviews.author: Jennifer

reviews.text: The atmosphere and decor of wolf is absolutely beautiful.  I love the concept.  The food was really good.  We got the goat cheese balls, Tuna Tartar, and the Caesar chicken wrap.  All were very delicious.  The berry sexy drink is really good as well if you want something non-alcoholic.
reviews.author: Julia

reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant/ atmosphere..our server was outstanding.  I made this reservation a month out for a birthday dinner and requested a table with a view, that did not happen which was disappointing for a Tuesday evening and our special occasion… we were seated inside just past the hostess stand.  Tables are very small… we had a party of 5 and were constantly needing to rearrange things to make some room.
reviews.author: Grady

reviews.text: Wolf is gorgeousl!  The decor is beyond spectacular.  The chandeliers overwhelming.  We did not have time after dinner to really explore, but I can't wait to go backk!!  Waiter and staff very accommodating.
reviews.author: arlene

reviews.text:
My wife and I went for her birthday and the waitress seemed a little forgetful and didn’t have the menu down, which is ok, because she may have been new. We had to repeatedly ask for our drinks.
We asked for a specific drink and received the opposite drink we asked for. We didn’t receive all of the of appetizers we ordered but they were removed from the bill. The steaks were cooked as ordered and juicy but weren’t flavored or seared at all. I’m assuming the service/steaks weren’t as good because we went in on a Monday.  The ambiance and decor was excellent. I wish the food and service had been a little bit better for the price.
reviews.author: Mason

reviews.text: Truly amazing! Already thinking about my next visit back!
reviews.author: Olivia

reviews.text: Made the mistake of reserving the last time slot for brunch at 2pm, for Easter. All food in chafing dishes was cold & hard. Nothing replenished. No new plates were put out for serve yourself buffet after 2:30. Omelet station was unmanned at 2:35. Had to ask a passing waiter to bring back employee so my youngest, 14 year old could get an omelet. She tried the scrambled eggs in chafing dish, but they were cold & like rubber. French toast in chafing dish was brick hard. I couldn't cut with knife.  So she needed that omelet. The place & employees were beautiful but food & service was poor. As a Lisa Vanderpump  fan, I was so excited to eat here. Huge disappointment. It was like speed eating. They wanted us out and we were done by 3pm. Almost $800 bill plus  20% tip. Wanted to come back for Mothers Day, but not now. I spend the same amount of money at Fairmont Princess.  At least they have clean plates for buffet and constantly replenish their buffet. Our waiter was friendly but food was horrible. Definitely not worth almost 1k price tag.
reviews.author: Terri

reviews.text: Our bill came to over $215 because there was an added service fee. It was supposed to be $75 per person. There was only two of us.. the only other thing we had was one glass of house, Prosecco. The buffet was out of almost everything, including all the dessert, the prime rib, and the chicken.. was a complete waste of time and money
reviews.author: Lindsey

reviews.text:
To be fair, our first and￼ only experience was Easter brunch buffet. For a restaurant that’s only been open for four months to take on this holiday was brave.

The restaurant itself is beautiful, elegant as expected. Great views, beautiful bar. Really top notch.

The food was “buffet good.” I’m not a huge fan of the serve-yourself experience, but for certain holidays buffet dining is the default option. By our 12:30 seating they had already begun to run out of some items. Not unusual. The carving station meats were well past their prime, with just the end cuts remaining. The dessert station was underwhelming, mostly breakfast danish. They ran out of macarons which we were all looking forward to. They seemed to have trouble keeping the sauces and condiments stocked, and could have used some sauce ramekins for serving.

That aside, the food was really good. Shrimp the size of a baby’s foot, plentiful crab legs, and crunchy but moist fried chicken were some of the favs. The omelette station was good, but the chef lacked a little finesse, turning out choppy but great tasting eggs.

Overall, a good experience. It left us all anxious to return for a proper plated meal very soon.
reviews.author: Patrick

reviews.text: Very disappointing holiday brunch… Ran out of many items halfway through the brunch and no one seemed to care ￼
reviews.author: Rod

reviews.text: It was my first time there this past Easter Sunday. And I must say it was absolutely beautiful. The food was delicious and the atmosphere was full of laughter. Beautiful place. I will be back.  ￼ The only thing that I was a little disappointed about was, once I was done eating, I wanted a little dessert and the only thing they had  was a bunch of little danishes. So maybe next Easter, I would suggest some nice small desserts .
reviews.author: LaVonda

reviews.text: Our family celebrated Easter brunch at Wolf. We had a wonderful time! The ambience and decor was fantastic, and the staff was super friendly. Our waitress was extra helpful and nice.  Our favorite was the delicious pastries. I highly recommend Wolf.
reviews.author: Adrienne

reviews.text:
This was a special night as we celebrated my wife’s birthday and this is where she wanted to spend it.  The staff was welcoming and accommodating. The ambiance and vibe was incredible and the food was great.
Can’t wait to go back.
Also, thank you for the amazing view of Scottsdale and camelback moutnain.
reviews.author: Bryan

reviews.text: Our experience was amazing , our server “Emily” was fantastic . Front the start she greeted us was such postive energy and always made sure we had what we needed , if we had any questions she knew the answers , she made us feel special and special day. She made us feel like we where the only ones she had even though she had other tables .
reviews.author: Audra

reviews.text: Great place for after dinner drinks and cocktails. Probably great for sunset drinks as well! We went after sunset.
reviews.author: Dr. Rishi

reviews.text: First time there. Everything was awesome.  Beautiful Restaurant.  Ambiance was great.
reviews.author: Michele

reviews.text: Arrived before reservation so we could enjoy a drink and view from rooftop veranda. The meal was very good, as was the service. Food arrived quickly and we had the bread with the bolognese dish which I recommend. We were there to celebrate a bday and had a nice complimentary dessert as well. Will return for sure! Loved the decor, food, service and overall experience!
reviews.author: April

reviews.text: Food and drinks were delicious. Service was a little slow. Restaurant was very loud(this was expected by my group but a watch out if that’s not what you’re looking for)
reviews.author: Teagan

reviews.text: Goat cheese balls are amazing. All the other food is very mid. Pretty pricey for just being mediocre. And you basically have to yell at each other because the music is so loud. Really cute decor though and gorgeous sunset views.
reviews.author: Georgeanne

reviews.text: Now my very last reservation. If my friend wasn’t expecting to see this place I would’ve cancelled. But hey, by some miracle, there could be some redemption, but it was the worst! Ok this time we didn’t wait 30 minutes with a reservation, just a few minutes but she gave us a table with the waitress from Denny’s. She was nice but so unprofessional. When there was no candle for their bday dessert, she took out her lighter in lieu of the candle for my friend to blow..what??!! And when she packed the butter, she said they have no extra knife so she used the other end of the used butter knife  on our table to scoop out the butter to put it in our to go container, creative but just super gross 🤮 you have cameras in your restaurant, look it up and see for yourself if that should be a proper demeanor.🤦🏼‍♀️🤦🏼‍♀️🤦🏼‍♀️
reviews.author: Ces

reviews.text: Rebecca was a great server! Gorgeous place, delicious drinks and food! We will be back.
reviews.author: Kat

reviews.text: The team, the service, and the cuisine were exceptional, and the atmosphere is breathtaking.
reviews.author: Risha

reviews.text: All the staff was amazing, the food exquisite, and their special martinis so delicious. It was a fantastic night
reviews.author: Brenda

reviews.text: Such a fun restaurant. No detail overlooked. Dinner was great. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: chava

reviews.text: Loved the food, the atmosphere, and our server! We went for my husbands bday and they all remembered and made it special for us both.
reviews.author: Hilary

reviews.text: The ambiance, food and service was outstanding! We’ll definitely be back. Nice job Lisa V.
reviews.author: Paul

reviews.text: I’ve been wanting to go to  Vanderpump restaurant, we went last night for a girls night and unfortunately was a very underwhelming experience.  The “filter” water that started us off tasted as if it was from the dirtiest tap handle out there and the server tried convincing us it’s because the pitch was accidentally tapped with their lemonade? We started with the wagyu sliders and hush puppies, and honestly should have stopped there. The sliders were the only thing I’d recommend to others. We then ordered the assorted cheese board, truffle fries, smoked wings, and the tomato cap salad. The cheese board just slabs of salami ( literally as I the kitchen just scoop big chucks) and cheeses that weren’t recognizable- our group only had a few bites the wings had zero flavor and the tomato salad didn’t either, the cheese served with it was a smaller portion than an actually tomato lol- we also had some cocktails which were fine. I  am such a foodie and was really disappointed in the value of the food, especially for the pricing. Bummed, got to try it- wouldn’t return.
reviews.author: alex

reviews.text: Came here to both celebrate my girlfriend's birthday and to compare this site to the Wolf in South Lake Tahoe.  A few differences:  Scottdale is darker (at least the section we sat in) and louder (low ceilings and overall space likely contributes to that).  Our server was very attentive.  We ordered:  1) shrimp cocktail - shrimp were huge, delicious, and well presented, 2) caviar and chips - it was ok, was not overly impressed, 3) tuna tartarre tostadas - only knock was the tuna was not very flavorful, which would have put this dish over the top as the portions were very generous.  Both drinks were well put together and good sized.  We also received the homemade chocolate brownie for her birthday, which was very tasty.  We liked the place, and will return at some point.  Overall a good place but I can't say great.
reviews.author: Paul

reviews.text: The 5 stars was for the waiter that served us, he was phenomenal but not for the female front desk receptionist. This receptionist made my previous all the way to the last time that I’ll ever make any reservations at Wolf. The front should be the beginning of a good experience. If it wasn’t for the waiter we had, the night would’ve been ruined. The food is not all that, it’s the ambience that is mostly the draw, and if the entire experience was good, I can get pass the entree selection in the menu cause I can just simply enjoy the evening, but it was a very unfortunate experience. My last reservation was no where near redemption 🤦🏼‍♀️
reviews.author: Ces

reviews.text: We've been to all of the Vanderpump restaurants in Las Vegas and this was our least favorite. Our cocktails were decent, if a bit warm. The goat cheese balls, which we've heard a lot about, are good, but need some herbs and spice (the hot honey is not hot at all). The crab and corn hush puppies were also good, but needed more corn and spice. The smash burger was excellent and the shrimp tacos were good, but needed less batter. We were surprised at the 3.5% "venue administration fee," whatever that is (no disclosure). The service and ambience are great. Although it was very good overall, it's a one and done for us.
reviews.author: Scott

reviews.text: The service was outstanding. Very knowledgeable and offered good suggestions. The restaurant is beautifully appointed. The tuna tartare was exceptional. Goat cheese balls are overwhelmingly strong. We did not care for the shrimp taco, and the New York filet was very fatty and tasted off. My suggestion would be to work off the Appetizer menu. Overall, a good experience.
reviews.author: Doug

reviews.text: Food was great and service was excellent. We will definitely go back!
reviews.author: Jennifer

reviews.text: Our food was a little slow coming out but our waiter was great and the food was outstanding.
reviews.author: Gary

reviews.text: Excellent waitress Nikki. Food was great.shared a bunch of apps. Amazing drinks.
reviews.author: Susan

reviews.text: Table outside was uncomfortable. Food mediocre and birthday celebration was underwhelming. Drinks very average. Been there before. Spent $1200 and manager asked us to move to patio seating while we wrapped up our bill. Wouldn’t seat us until all 12 people were there. Then ask us to leave while wrapping our bill up. Service to a long time which is why we were there over 2 hours.
reviews.author: Cindy

reviews.text: I wouldn’t eat here again. Fun to go once for the novelty.
reviews.author: Kim

reviews.text: Absolutely electric vibe at the wolf! We are staying here for my wife’s birthday and really enjoyed our experience at the bar and then dinner. Will definitely be going back throughout the week. Awesome!
reviews.author: Greg

reviews.text: Great new restaurant and the food and service was incredible. On top of the Caesars Republic hotel on the 7th floor.
reviews.author: Steven

reviews.text: The waitress made our experience less enjoyable. She seemed rushed all the time, didn’t give much attention to the table, and wasn’t attentive to guest who might have needed anything. Everything else was perfect.
reviews.author: Ghazwan

reviews.text: Everything was good except the food was just ok. Wouldn’t go back for that, but it’s a cool vibe for drinks with friends. Not great for a couples date tho because it’s way too loud to hear one another talk.
reviews.author: Jessica

reviews.text: Our server was wonderful. The restaurant is beautifully decorated food was great.
reviews.author: Julie

reviews.text:
We celebrated my 60th birthday.  From the minute we walked in, had a drink at the bar and throughout our dinner,  everything was wonderful.  Emily our server was just a beautiful kind soul.  She made us feel so special.  Food was delicious and tasty.  Drinks were fantastic.  The  restaurant is over the top gorgeous.

Overall,  the best experience.  The atmosphere is upbeat, lively and so fun.  If this is not your vibe, not a place for you.
It is so nice to be out and everyone is so happy!
reviews.author: Ron

reviews.text: Amazing experience! We have been to all the Vanderpump restaurants so we had high expectations, and they were surpassed. They sat us at a beautiful table by the window. It had great views, marbled table, cute chairs that matched the “Wolf” theme, and little cushion chair for your bag. The restaurant is beautiful. The theming is on point, they have beautiful wolf statues and it really transports you to another place. Emily took such great care of us and was one of the sweetest people. She made the experience so special and was so attentive. The drinks were great and also beautiful. The food was delicious. We’ve had the goat cheese balls at the other restaurants and these were one of the best. The caviar was great for a fist timer. All our food was delicious. We also sat at the bar after our meal and Jaylen was great! The bar is also very beautiful and really fun as well and we met fun people. Overall great experience would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Gilbert

reviews.text:
We went for a family dinner with our kids. Food was great!! Then…
Waiter spilt ketchup on the back of my son’s shirt - didn’t say sorry. I had to clean up his shirt. The waiter laughed it off. Management never came by to apologize for the waiters ￼behavior.

Won’t be back!
reviews.author: Tracey

reviews.text: Such great food, drinks, and atmosphere! Our server Ashton was amazing and made our experience even better! Will be back!
reviews.author: Kayleigh

reviews.text: Absolutely love this place! It’s beautiful, the food is perfect, the ambiance is perfect, drinks are delicious! My most favorite place!
reviews.author: Alex & Jennifer

reviews.text: I loved the vibe of the restaurant and the people were nice but the food was inedible.  I have eaten at other LVP spots and had similar experiences.  Go for the cocktails and vibe but eat before you go.
reviews.author: Vanessa

reviews.text: Absolutely stunning to look at and be seen. Food was great drinks were perfection. Great for dates, friends, or family. The sunset views are unmatched, would definitely recommend
reviews.author: Kate

reviews.text: As a vanderpump rules fan, I was SO excited to eat here! It’s absolutely stunning inside and the design of the restaurant was beautifully designed with every detail. The food was definitely pricey however it was good. I wouldn’t recommend the wolf bread as it was extremely flakey and bland tasting. The famous goat cheese balls were DELISH. I ended up getting the burger and I wasn’t disappointed with that! However, service wise- our waitress was amazing but my father got the steak. When the food runner came to drop off the food, she accidentally spilt the steak sauce all over my father’s leg, my jeans, and my mother’s dress. We totally understand mistakes happen and didn’t want her to feel embarrassed at all & she apologized for the mis-hap. When a new sauce was delivered by what seemed upper management, we weren’t given an apology or offered anything as all of our outfits were now stained. We brushed it off though and continued to enjoy our evening. 20 minutes late that Same food runner dropped another plate of food all of the another guest’s table. For how much money was spent, I would expect the restaurant to properly take care of their guests when this stuff happens.
reviews.author: Mikaya

reviews.text:
We had an event for 10 women. A Birtbday Party.
The server was terrible. We waited 40 minutes for drinks. Mainly Soft Drinks. We couldn’t get him to order. I personally ordered tuna and he gave me lobster.
I told him we had a hard Finnish on time as he just ignored me. He bought the the Biryhday Desert after the Bday girl left.
I was there for dinner another time and service was not good either.
Very Disappointing
reviews.author: Lucia

reviews.text:
Absolutely amazing experience from the food to the service. We ordered the shrimp tacos, sliders, and churros, and every single bite was delicious. The kitchen is very fast, and the portions are ample for the price—definitely felt like a great value.

The staff was incredibly attentive and kept the night moving perfectly. The only slight downfall was the noise level near the 3rd bar; a very loud, intoxicated party was a bit obnoxious and slightly impacted the ambiance. However, the quality of the meal and the hospitality more than made up for it. I’d highly recommend it!
reviews.author: DAWN

reviews.text: Great food and great service.  The ambience is on par
reviews.author: Kayla

reviews.text: Everything was perfect (food, ambiance, service, cocktail, etc.) until we got the check which included a 3.5% service fee. That was totally unexpected. It would be nice to be informed (maybe print it on the menu in bold letters?) that this service fee will be charged and not be surprised (negatively) when presented with the check.
reviews.author: Anna

reviews.text: We enjoyed ourselves! Our waitress was top notch. Great place to host my dinner party!
reviews.author: Kristy

reviews.text: Came in for a 9 top for my friends birthday. We originally had 8 but they accommodated us for 9 people last minute which was very nice of them! We had drinks and plenty of food. We were all extremely pleased with the drinks. Balanced, not overly sweet, and creative. The food was also very good, we did not have any complaints about the food and I would like to return to try more! The only thing I felt negatively about were pieces of the service - when we sat, we waited a pretty long time to be greeted/receive waters. Our server was very friendly and accommodating though. The process of receiving food and drinks was a little unorganized, it seems like staff is trained to just auction off drinks and food and place them wherever, not sure if it’s just because of the size of the party/limited space on table or what. Not a huge deal though, we still thoroughly enjoyed our time!
reviews.author: Audra

reviews.text: This restaurant was the culmination of our trip.  I was so excited to go!  The restaurant is beautiful  and the details are impeccable.  However, the service was horrific.  Our reservation was at 8pm and the restaurant was lively but many tables were clearing out.  Our server did not even acknowledge us until 25 minutes of waiting.  We ordered drinks and appetizers right away.  They did not come until 9pm!  We had been there an hour.  That was ridiculous!  Now there was a table behind us and they had already received two rounds of appetizers, and drinks and were seated after us!  Yes, these were attractive young woman and I am a 52 year old Mom of two.  No idea if that had anything to do with it, but it felt like that.  A gentleman who said he was a manager stopped over and did speak with us, but then proceeded to sit down with his group of women for over 45 minutes providing them additional comped drinks and food while we sat there like peasants.  Our dinner finally came around 925.  It was very average.  No one came to check how it was.  We were offered a free dessert which was nice.  However we had to wait an additional 1/2 hour to get our check and change.  All the while this supposed manager was yucking it up with these college girls getting free shots, and appetizers.  Never again looked in our direction or checked on us.  I actually have to say I felt extremely insecure and humiliatied.
reviews.author: Nikki

reviews.text: Steak was good but food took forever. Restaurant is very nice inside
reviews.author: Amy

reviews.text: Very negative experience. Seated at a congested 4-top at the bar with uncomfortable chairs, jammed between a booth with a dog and a 2-top, with back against a railing. Between the noise at the bar and the wait staff continually in and out of the kitchen it was miserable. Meals were served COLD and the overall food was adequate. The goat cheese balls aren’t that great. Wait staff was fine but not professionally trained. Manager showed lip service void valid concern. DO NOT RECOMMEND.
reviews.author: Char

reviews.text: Jon, our waiter, was absolutely perfect for the job. He was enthusiastic, attentive & had great suggestions with questions we had for him.
reviews.author: Pamela

reviews.text:
We attended dinner at Wolf for my birthday.
Our reservation was at 6pm, we called ahead as we hit traffic unexpectedly and were about 15min late. 
While professional, the hostess’ tended to focus on their own conversation and less on the guests. While they acknowledged each guest, I observed a sense of “better than” exuding from the hostesses. 
Tip: I had a boss say “you treat the janitor the same as you treat the customer in a 5pc suit. Why? Because you don’t know someone’s lifestyle, financial situation just by their clothing.” 

Anyways, the hostess that seated us walked fast - I was toddling, pregnant and in heels while my husband was carrying our 19mo old son in one arm and I had his other arm for balance. The hostess seemed annoyed that we were delayed, both by traffic and by my walking slow and carefully. We asked for a high chair for our son, “you want me to get what now?”…my husband had to repeat himself and then, topping off, procure it himself because the hostess seemingly couldn’t be bothered. 

Deep breath! I wasn’t going to let our first meeting weight the entire night. Tonight was about ME and u determined to enjoy! And I’m glad we reserved our criticism for this moment and not in the moment. 

The young man that took our drink order was friendly and prompt. Our server, Barrett was fantastic and very personable! We will come back just for him! And Amyc while she wasn’t our direct server, she was just a gem! She interacted with our son, while maintaining her tables as well. Just a friendly spirit and wonderful light for the evening! 
The food? The drinks? Let me tell ya! Vanderpump never disappoints in her thoughtful curating of fine cuisine and cocktail. 
I had the 12oz NY Strip and an Emerald Bay mocktail. The chimchuri ague was fabulous! And this is coming from someone that hates to use any sauce on her meats! 
My husband had the salmon. We shared the Mac and cheese and partook in the goat cheese balls and caviar and chips. 
Worth. Every. Cent.
reviews.author: Melodye

reviews.text: Its very cool place love the decor! I liked it so much I came back two more times while I was staying at Cesars
reviews.author: Luciana

reviews.text: Wife and I went for a date night there. Meal consisted of wolf bread and two filet mignon entrée and the brownie dessert, no alcoholic beverages. Plating was eye catching, food cooked to order, and everything was spot on. Music was touch loud but fit in with the Saturday night crowd. Server Gigi was very attentive and friendly. Overall experience would rate a 9.5 and go again.
reviews.author: Jason

reviews.text: Food’s okay, but you’re not really there for the food. Service started out bumpy, but got better. Server dropped off appetizer plates while we had those GIANT menus still sitting at the table and rather than taking our entree orders, she bailed and left us with those GIANT menus still in hand. We got the bread app (which was great) but she kept trying to take it away with half a loaf left, even asking if we wanted a box before entrees arrived. Weird. She got better after that, but for the price  the food is an average. Cool vibe though.
reviews.author: erik

reviews.text: This was our first visit and we will certainly be back. We forfeited our table and got seats at the bar. The decor is just beautiful. We had a beet salad and filet mignon split. They were both generous portions. ￼ ￼ the drinks were great and the service by Joey at the bar was fantastic. It’s a bit out of our way from where we live, but we will definitely be back. ￼
reviews.author: Danette

reviews.text: As others say, it’s a great setting especially if your request for a nice table is honored. (Ours wasn’t, no big deal.) But the food is just ok and the wine list needs work both in terms of diversity and value. The servers have been pretty nice and the bartenders are engaging. Anyways, it’s fine to check out once.
reviews.author: bob

reviews.text: Overall it was a great experience. Food and cocktails were great, presentation of the cocktails were next level as well. Atmosphere is energetic and fun, wife and I will go back again. Great service as well.
reviews.author: George

reviews.text: My request for a window table was accommodated. I was so excited! All of the food we had was incredible. Goat cheese balls, of course! Pumpini, ✔️. We had the crab balls and cheeseburger with fries.  The atmosphere, the vibe, the service, and the dj. All of it is top-notch.
reviews.author: Trish

reviews.text: LOVE this place! So chic and amazing in so many ways! Love their cocktails, food and the atmosphere is on point!
reviews.author: Mindy

reviews.text:
Food was amazing as always, but I was let down, a tad, because they were not serving the frose on their drink menu.  I was super excited to get a frose because I can’t find anywhere here in Arizona today has them.
Our waiter was amazing
reviews.author: Lisa

reviews.text:
I loved wolf by vanderpump.
We went for lunch on a Friday.
The hotel it is in is lively, the decor of the restaurant is stunning!
My only issue was lots of tables with stools.
Comfy stools to be fair, but No one wants this, you need to be able to relax,
Food was delicious the bread to start is delicious, we also got chips and dips, which to be fair was very nice lots of fresh crudités, it’s large! but again I would have preferred literally chips with the two delicious dips,
I like that the menu is small - ensuring everything is done well.
It has a good cocktail list, and wine selection, but could do with at least 1 extra rose selection by the glass, the one rose is vanderpump’s own & while drinkable it’s not amazing.

It is quite expensive… and I’m not sure what it is your getting for your money, the view is only worth seeing from a few tables, otherwise your looking at toca modera & lifetime fitness,

But all in all I enjoyed the atmosphere, our waitress was friendly, the music they play is modern, the food is nice & I will be back again. Maybe next time il try the evening vibes,
reviews.author: Shirley

reviews.text:
The Cobb salads were very unexciting….
The table for 10 on the patio was too wide for good conversation. Very hard to hear friends across the table.  
It was a very hot day, but the shade, fans, misters made it very comfortable. 
They would not seat most of our party until everyone was there & made a s point to say we only had the table for a limited time….which was not very welcoming.

reviews.text:
The ambiance is beautiful and definitely feels upscale, but the experience didn’t live up to it. The patio doors were left open, making the inside uncomfortably warm, which took away from the overall atmosphere.

Service was slow, and our second round of drinks didn’t arrive until after we had finished eating. For the price point, I expected much better attention to detail.

reviews.text: Ambiance was spectacular.  Very posh and exotic.  We asked for a sunset view table and that was phenomenal.  Gorgeous view!  Burger and goat cheese balls were good.  Salmon and filet not so much.  Side items on salmon and filet plate were terrible.  Fish and meat not great.  Go for the sunset and ambiance!

reviews.text: Unfortunately, Our first visit & birthday dinner was a Big disappointment. It was difficult to make a reservation and Despite finally having a reservation, the hostess was very rude, the manager was condescending & our tiny table and seating for 6 was very uncomfortable. The restaurant was very warm (no a/c?) While the wait staff was excellent and the decor was beautiful, the overall experience did not meet expectations, and we are unlikely to return.

reviews.text: Server forgot about me until I went to tell the host. Super disappointed as well as I chose to celebrate my birthday there but received less than par service. Did it once and don’t need to return again. Food was good though
reviews.author: Melina

reviews.text: Gorgeous restaurant, lighting unique and amazing! Service was on the slower side. Food was great! Loved the views.
reviews.author: Lisa

People are actually reserving the table they want to sit at?  Oh yes in the note.  Total BS. Thank the dark haired hostess.

reviews.text: Overall great experience! We came for a business dinner and had a wonderful time.

reviews.text:
Decor is amazing, wonderful views, the staff was wonderful and the food was outrageously delicious!

reviews.text: This was the worst experience of my life. It took 2 hours for us to get our checks we literally twiddle our thumbs, the servers were just standing around and we were only checked in on twice before we had to ask a bus boy to get our waitress for our checks and then it took us another 30 minutes after that. reviews.text: Perfect experience!  The ambience is exceptional!!
reviews.author: Rachel

reviews.text:
Beautifully decorated and a fabulous view especially sunset. All the staff was very accommodating, helpful, and pleasant. I had the famous goat cheese balls, which were the most delicious thing I have ever had, and I also had the Filet Mignon which was cooked beautifully at a medium rare that I requested. Beautiful restaurant and lovely staff! It was my friend's birthday, and they treated him wonderfully and took a picture with the sunset. 
 We definitely will be back!
reviews.author: Amy

reviews.text:
We recently celebrated Starlyss’ birthday at Wolf at Caesars Republic Scottsdale, and the entire experience delivered from start to finish.

From the moment we were seated, the setting set the tone—paired with a magnificent Arizona sunset that made the evening feel special before the first sip or bite even hit the table.

The bar program stood out right away. Their bourbon selection is solid and thoughtfully curated, and the cocktail menu brings a creative edge that keeps things interesting whether you’re a classic sipper or looking to explore something new.

When it came to the food, every dish was well-prepared, flavorful, and presented with care. You can tell there’s intention behind the menu—nothing felt rushed or overlooked.

What truly elevated the experience was the service. Attentive without being intrusive, detailed, and genuinely warm—exactly what you want for a celebration dinner.

Wolf has officially earned a spot as a go-to date night destination. Whether you’re celebrating something special or just looking for a refined night out in Scottsdale, it delivers 💯
reviews.author: Milton

reviews.text:
Villa Blanca, SUR, Pump, Vanderpump Paris all great and now adding this to the list
Love her style!!
reviews.author: Amy

reviews.text: Amy was amazing! Drinks were great, food was tasty.
reviews.author: Christian

reviews.text: Our waitress was very nice. They have a huge long bar. The drinks are roughly $21 each, the good was probably on an average of $31 if your not getting a filet . I think I paid $60 for wife's filet, Wife said filet was really good. My food was really good, the homemade bread was outstanding. We would definitely eat there again if we visit this area in future

reviews.text: We had the absolute best server. Coco was attentive, happy and overall a pleasure. Drinks were great and came out pretty quickly. Food was good but took way too long to come out. However, we will be back again
reviews.author: Leslie

reviews.text: Absolutely loved Wolf by Vanderpump. The ambience and views of Camelback Mountain are stunning, the drinks were fantastic, and the food did not disappoint. The goat cheese balls are worth the hype. Such a fun vibe!
reviews.author: Cara

reviews.text: Vibes and drinks unmatched! Great way to celebrate my birthday.

reviews.text: Everything was good until we got the bill.  They charge a special service fee of about 5% that was unexpected.

reviews.text: I booked us a gorgeous table for a best friend’s birthday and we loved it. The ambiance is the absolute best
reviews.author: Sabrina

reviews.text: Staff is amazing! Food was so good! The whole thing, the decor, open window, and cocktails were too notch! Love it!
reviews.author: Brandon

reviews.text:
Beautiful ambiance. The food was decent but not great.
￼Caesar salad, bread, and goat cheese balls were tasty. The shrimp was overcooked and were warm not chilled. The caviar and chips needed way more crème fresh. The drinks were overpriced but my martini was divine. The service was horrible. There were no serving utensils to serve and share our plates with. After our waitress took our order we never saw her again and sat with empty water glasses and no cocktails for WAY TOO LONG. I made the reservation because it was my friends birthday and it was never even acknowledged. It wasn’t that busy and the lack of attention to detail should not have been overlooked. Disappointed

reviews.text: It’s a vibe. The food was better than expected and the ambience is different and fun. The noise level is very loud. Out server was really nice but very busy and drinks took an unusually long time…even just for a bottle of wine.
reviews.author: Laura

reviews.text: Wolf by Vanderpump was an extraordinary experience. Everything from the ambiance and decor to the amazing menu. Drinks and entrees were superb and the service was impeccable. I would highly recommend this location for not only a special occasion dinner, but for a go-to for dinner and drinks anytime. Tastefully classy in all ways and a truly exceptional experience. Must try the goat cheese balls!!
reviews.author: Gabriele

reviews.text: highly recommend! ambiance and vibes are chefs kiss. get there early, and get a drink at the terrace one floor up! Rebecca, thank you for taking such great care of us!!
reviews.author: Kelly

reviews.text: Amy and Emi made the experience so much fun! The cocktails were delicious and food excellent. Can’t wait to come back.
reviews.author: paige

reviews.text: Go here for the atmosphere, not the food. There is a lively energetic vibe and the restaurant is beautiful. Great views of Camelback Mountain.  The Goat Cheese Balls and Heirloom Beets were just ok. the bread had no flavor and almost tasted stale.  I never add salt to my food as I am not a big salt fan but I had to add salt to the Chilean Sea Bass to give it some flavor. The sliders were just pretty basic flavorless.  It's not over expensive considering it's located in Scottsdale but if you're looking for fine dining Wolf is not it!
reviews.author: Suanne

reviews.text: Exceptional venue, great menu offerings for all price ranges.
reviews.author: Dan

reviews.text: Disappointed, not happy with the food!  Fried foot too much breading not enough fish!  Hush puppies not that impressive.
reviews.author: Marcia

reviews.text: Absolutely amazing! A must try! Lisa knows how to do a sexy restaurant !
reviews.author: Tori

reviews.text: Great lunch spot with fabulous ambiance, wide windows for an open air feel on nice days, and a varied menu.  Service was good except we had to pour our own champagne throughout the entire meal. The Vanderpump sparkling brut was excellent. We had Cobb salads with shrimp instead of chicken. They were very good.  The brownie dessert was very generous and tasty. The option to make their desserts boozy was unique but after a bottle of champagne we opted out. I’m sure nights are a totally different vibe. The bar area looks great and we’ll be back for a cocktail and something from their generous appetizer menu.
reviews.author: Lesley

reviews.text: My husband and I did a Friday early date and got there at opening. From the hostess through the server and foods runners and other staff they all were amazing. We especially loved the crab and corn hush puppies. We both love specialty cocktails and we’re not disappointed.
reviews.author: Lori

reviews.text: Wolf is a very chic, very elegant, beautifully decorated restaurant with an amazing service staff. My issue was the food. My wife and I ordered lobster ceviche crisps and the Wolf bread for appetizers, both were wonderful. For our main courses my wife ordered the 6oz filet mignon and I ordered the  12oz NY strip both were to be prepared medium rare. When the food arrived (which was extremely quick) my wife and I were excited to begin eating. As I was looking at my steak I noticed the color was a bit light for a grilled steak, my wife informed me that the steak was likely cooked “sous vide” which is cooked in a hot water bath inside a vacuum sealed bag and then seared on the grill. If this is how they prepared my steak then they completely forgot to sear one side and barely let the one side hit the grill at all. The first bite of my steak had to be spat out as the taste was way off. I gave the steak a smell test and immediately knew the meat was spoiled. My wife’s filet was great and she enjoyed it immensely but my night was ruined. The manager offered to have the kitchen cook me a new steak but once you’ve had spoiled meat in your mouth you’re pretty much done with meat for the next 24 to 48 hours.
reviews.author: Jason

reviews.text: Our party of 4 was disappointed in the service and quality of food we experienced during a lunch visit. The wait staff seemed to be very inexperienced, and the food was not what we expected from a Vanderpump restaurant.
reviews.author: Brooke

reviews.text: Worth the price point / the Nay strip, and short rib with goat cheese balls
reviews.author: Ashley

reviews.text: For what it is, it’s overpriced and underwhelming.
reviews.author: Rachael

reviews.text: Enjoyed my lunch here as this was my second time. Beautiful inside of the restaurant, service was great and I enjoyed the fish-n-chips. Also has nice views of Camelback Mountain.
reviews.author: Ross

reviews.text: What a beautiful restaurant!  My sister and I had the pleasure of celebrating her birthday with lunch at Wolf.  So pretty!  Lunch choices were great and delicious.  The Lisa Aperol Spritz was so good.  Our server was very personable and attentive.   I would highly recommend!!
reviews.author: Cathy

reviews.text: Excellent service, food and atmosphere!  And the view is amazing.
reviews.author: Laura

reviews.text: Excellent Servers. Anna and her waiter in training were great. Mike the bartender also took great care of us. Food and wine also very good. Will be back for sure.

reviews.text: This is my 2nd visit to Wolf. The restaurant is absolutely stunning, beautiful and sexy! This time unfortunately our food was just so-so. We had the Wolf Burger, and the french fries were cold, and the Shrimp tacos were so heavily breaded that we had to peal off the coating.  We also ordered the Wolf bread, which is good, but not $16.00 good. The drinks are very pretty, but maybe a bit over priced for a spritz drink, which was $26.00.  I would definitely go back for the atmosphere, but probably just for drinks and maybe an appetizer.
reviews.author: Johanna

reviews.text: The only thing that was tasty where the goat cheese balls. The menus are physically, huge, as well as the chairs. The table is completely uncomfortable to sit in. The service was mediocre at best. Our orders came out wrong and we told the waitress and she basically just said oh sorry. Nothing was taken off our menu for any of the mistakes with the food. The food overall was a D plus drinks were sugary and overpriced. Luna‘s hands-down is the still the best restaurant at Caesars.
reviews.author: Adrian

reviews.text:
Hostess and server were wonderful. Appetizers were delicious, the goat cheese balls and lobster ceviche were as delicious as they were beautiful. The salmon was fine, a little dry, but good flavor. However the steaks left a lot to be desired. The filet was ordered medium and was served medium well to nearly well done. There was a slight hint of pink, but it was definitely overdone. The ribeye was prepared medium rare as requested, but the steak had significantly more fat and grizzle than I typically see from a steakhouse or fine dining restaurant. 
At almost $100 a steak, I expected a better cut. Great atmosphere, I might go back for cocktails and apps…but I’ll pass on the steaks!
reviews.author: Scott

reviews.text: Not impressed with the food.  I had a steak salad and it did not have any flavor at all.  For the price I expected better food.
reviews.author: Isabel

reviews.text: My fries were cold both times they brought them out.
reviews.author: Patrick

reviews.text: Menus are obnoxiously large. Strange decor blocking one of the best views in town. Cocktails were great. Food was extremely mediocre. Our entrees arrived before our appetizers had been cleared and we weren’t offered refills/additional drinks. They forgot our salad course entirely. $20 glass of red wine served at room temp (80 degrees here in AZ). Big disappointment overall. Not anything like our experience at Villa Blanca, SUR and Tom Tom in LA.
reviews.author: Thomas

reviews.text:
very disappointed in the food, nothing special at all, many of the ingredients did not work together. the service was terrible, the kitchen was slow, which can happen but it was the combination of the entire experience-  despite reservations took very long to seat us, 2 of the wines we wanted were out, and  our server wasn’t great so made me think the restaurant is poorly run.  server did not do simple things like pour our glasses of wine, check in on us, etc…
however, the restaurant is beautiful & love the ambiance. i have a feeling this place is popular solely cuz it’s owned by a reality star.

reviews.text: Very beautiful restaurant.  Service and food was excellent.  City and mountain views from the restaurant and patio.  Will definitely be back.
reviews.author: Renee

reviews.text: Dinner Reservation ordered Sea Bass which was over cooked, she sent it back, and just ate the Outstanding Beet Salad. Ordered Fish Tacos which were fried and mediocre at best. Why they can't do grilled idk. Free desert for the Sea Bass mishap.  Lovely decor, beautiful views. Great service.
reviews.author: Richard

reviews.text: Great spot! We did a girls night and it was perfect.  Cocktail to start and a nice glass of wine to finish! The bread and butter was chefs 💋

reviews.author: Courtney

reviews.text: Appetizers were great. Food for lunch was average. Drinks were very good!! Loved the vibe!
reviews.author: Rachel

reviews.text: Excellent experience!  We had a wonderful and knowledgeable waitress.  We went for a late lunch.  We had the burger, chicken wrap and cobb salad.  All delicious!  The drinks were also very good.  Loved the decor and openess.  The next time I will know to ask for a table by the window.  Love the fact that they were open.
reviews.author: Gary

reviews.text:
This is a stunning restaurant. Decor is beautiful and elegant.  Service was great even with it being a busy night. Albeit the hostess was a bit huffy.

Good was fun and lovely presentation.

Once the Dj kicked in we could no longer converse across the table.

Regardless. High energy. Loved that tables were large and spaced apart. Not crowded.

Very fun night!
reviews.author: rose

reviews.text: Dinner for four was fabulous.  Wide menu choices and table service was excellent.  Ambience and nighttime views were great too.  Looking forward to our return experience!
reviews.author: David

reviews.text: Amy, our server, was amazing! She made it extra special for the birthday girl and the kids. Food and drinks were outstanding. Beautiful view. 10 out of 10 recommend!
reviews.author: Angie

reviews.text: Great decor! Overall, food was good. Great tuna tartare and bread. The vegetables were undercooked on the salmon plate and the salmon appeared to be farm-raised - which I don't prefer. Lovely waitstaff and drinks! Would come back!
reviews.author: Mereena

reviews.text: We had a great time dining at Wolf. The hostesses were warm and welcoming. Our waitress, Nicole, was super friendly. The atmosphere is absolutely fantastic! It is such a fun place to eat out. Our food was fantastic. I highly recommend!
reviews.author: Adrienne

reviews.text: We went for my birthday dinner and it was so great! We had a great service I believe our servers name was Emily. She made great suggestions and added in some thoughtful birthday touches. Caviar was delicious as well as the wolf bread and waygu sliders. Lastly, highly recommend the huff & puff old fashioned 🫡
reviews.author: Ally

reviews.text: Exceptional food and service.  Sophisticated elegance and upbeat vibe.  Highly recommend
reviews.author: Peter

reviews.text: From the moment walking in to leaving everything was exceptional. Drinks were timely and stunning. The bread was unlike anything I've tasted. Goat cheese balls definitely live up to their hype. We had the sea bass, burger, caviar, salad, and a special touch for celebrating my birthday. 100/10 recommend and any time I'm in town I will be back even if just for a glass of incredible Vanderpump champagne 🥂
reviews.author: Elizabeth

reviews.text:
Beautiful restaurant with perfect ambience, stunning décor, and great vibes. The bar is lovely and the cocktails are outstanding—my Peter Rabbit was beautifully presented and well balanced.

Unfortunately, the food fell short. The goat cheese balls and fish and chips both lacked seasoning, and the batter on the fish wasn’t enjoyable. The manager was kind and offered a replacement, but the shrimp tacos used the same batter, so the flavors felt repetitive.

Fantastic drinks and atmosphere—just hoping for more flavorful, well‑seasoned dishes in the future.
reviews.author: Sharon

reviews.text: Classy, elegant, romantic, funky, fabulous views.   We had incredible service by Kelsey; ordered sophisticated cocktails while enjoying this posh new restaurant.   We could not decide whether we should have dinner but ultimately decided upon having 4 different appetizers.....amazing!   The goat cheese balls, sliders, lobster tacos and the tuna tartar tostados were incredibly delicious.  Either for a special occasion, a casual dinner, drinks at the bar.....we will be back soon.  Well done!!
reviews.author: Carol

reviews.text: Wolf by Vanderpump was an amazing experience from start to finish. The atmosphere is absolutely stunning, with beautiful decor and a unique vibe that makes the whole experience feel special. The food was incredible, everything we ordered was flavorful, well-prepared, and beautifully presented. The drinks were phenomenal and some of the best we’ve had, both creative and delicious. The service was also excellent and made the entire experience even better. If you’re looking for a memorable dining experience with amazing food, outstanding cocktails, and a beautiful atmosphere, Wolf by Vanderpump is definitely worth a visit.
reviews.author: Esmeralda

reviews.text: Our waiter was amazing!! He helped us get the best drinks and food for our dinner
reviews.author: Crystal

reviews.text: Excellent choice for a nice dinner out. The restaurant is off the charts quirky, elegant and gorgeous. Our server Megan was outstanding and very helpful. Highly recommend the cheese ball appetizer, the tuna tartar appetizer, the salmon buerre blanc entree and the burger. We didn’t get dessert. Good selection of mocktails that were tasty. And get there by 6::15 to enjoy the spectacular sunset views. Valet parking is easy.
reviews.author: DAVID

reviews.text:
You only get one chance to make a first impression.
Ours was not good.
We had a 5:00 pm reservation, I had requested a table by the window. There were 3 or 4 young women at the hostess station, I gave them our name and said we had 5 o'clock reservations. Very unfriendly and snooty. We followed our hostess around the bar to the far end and she showed us a small table across from the bar. My husband told her we had asked for a table by the window, which there were plenty available. She said, oh the hostess will have to check.  So we had to follow her all the way back to the hostess station. They whispered to each other, then she took us to a table by the window.  We almost left but decided give it a try.
We were pleasantly surprised the server and food excellent!
They need to fix the issue at the hostess station!
reviews.author: Jerry

reviews.text: Took my wife here for her birthday. We loved it. The ambience and views were fantastic. We had a great server and the food was delicious (we had the goat cheese balls, tuna tartare for appetizers. She had the risotto and I had the brisket bolognese). Recommended!
reviews.author: Francis

reviews.text: We sat at the bar and had great service and celebrated my friends birthday. Towards the end of the night kitchen had just closed, but Victor at the bar talked to the kitchen and was able to put a birthday brownie together and that made her night.
reviews.author: Eric

reviews.text:
Beautiful experience at Wolf! Especially impressive for a brand-new restaurant. Lauren was our server and she was absolutely amazing — attentive, warm, and professional. Jolene, an assistant manager(?) also added such thoughtful touches, including seating us by a window with a terrific view and surprising us with an extra complimentary dessert for our birthday girls’ night out.
The food was excellent, the décor is stunning, and the atmosphere is romantic and swanky — perfect for date night or a special celebration. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Monica

reviews.text: This was our second time there and we were celebrating our daughter‘s birthday. Nicole was our server and I really can’t say enough about her! She was so fun and friendly and really added to the overall incredible vibe of this restaurant. The food is excellent — best short rib Bolognese we’ve ever had, and the chicken was also delicious! Love the atmosphere and decor. Our bartender, (I can’t remember his name, but he had tattoos on one of his arms) was so fun and ￼helped make her birthday special. Excellent service all the way around. We can’t wait to come back! ￼
reviews.author: Jenny

reviews.text:
After waiting no more than 5 minutes for our reservation, we were shown to our table – a very nice table by the window.  The seats were comfortable, but not all seats in the restaurant were.  

We had the BUTTER SEARED CHILEAN SEABASS, which was quite good, BRISKET & TRI TIP BOLOGNESE, which was stringy and chewy and contained very little pasta and BEURRE BLANC SALMON, which was horribly overcooked and the kitchen forgot the beurre blanc and the pommes Anna that are supposed to come with it.

We hoped that dessert would be better.  However, our server decided we didn’t need dessert.  Right after they cleared the dishes, he brought us the check, which contained a ridiculous 3.5% JUNK FEE.  So, we paid and left.  (We stopped and got ice cream on the way home).  Also, they made no effort to acknowledge my mother’s birthday, which they knew about.  Classy places will usually make a small gesture (a cheap glass of champagne or a small dessert with a candle.)  Not here. Nothing.  Don’t waste your money – there are far better places in Scottsdale (one right across the street).
reviews.author: Christopher

reviews.text: I had such high hopes for this restaurant. I’ve been to several other Vanderpump locations and always found them  to be great. Wolf was just not quite there. The bright spot was their sommelier. The wine list was not as extensive as I would have thought for the price point. Several servers had dirty uniforms on. While our server was very sweet, the service was disconnected and didn’t flow. The food was just meh! Don’t waste your money on the caviar appetizer. The potato chips over power the caviar especially the small amount they give you.￼  The salads were subpar at best. The “verde chimichurri” on the steak was stringy and super salty. ￼ The churro dessert was tasty and delightful.
reviews.author: Jaime

reviews.text:
We had the worst experience possible. We had a reservation for 1:30pm and arrived for our reservation at 1:20pm and was told we’d be sat in just a minute. My mother in law is disabled but can do short distances with a walker.
