At 1:25 my wife asked the hostess how long it would be so we knew if we should have her sit (getting up and down is difficult) or continue to wait stand. The hostess snapped back “your reservation is for 1:30, you will be seated at 1:30!”

That was only the beginning. Once seated it took 45 minutes to even get a drink. We put an appetizer order and 30 minutes later (now 1 hour 15 min in) our server came back asking if we wanted to order any appetizers. One drink was brought out at a time with one of the people in our party of 5 not getting their drink for 60 minutes from sitting

The server never acknowledged what a ridiculous experience this was.

The place is very pretty and the views are great but the service and food are unacceptable.
reviews.author: Geoff

reviews.text: Everything was great except it took over 45 minutes to get our meal. All we had was a salad and salmon at lunch time. Not a huge amount of people for lunch.  I did get a free dessert for my birthday, that was really nice. Even though we were not in a hurry. 45 minutes is a bit for waiting for food. Could of had some bread on the table. I will be back again.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Had a 8:30 pm reservation did not get seated for 35 Minutes   Was sat in the far back corner   For 4 of us  it was a table for 8    Horrible!!!!!
Slow service   Food was average  will   not go back  not to mention we were told to go to the rooftop bar to get a cocktail to wait and they ran out of glassware so we drank martinis out of plastic cups. It was great.   Omg  !!!!🫣
reviews.author: Trudy

reviews.text: To start off with my reservation was at 8 PM. Didn’t get to sit down till 845-ish. Our server was very nice. She always had a smile on her face and presented her herself well. We ordered the famous goat cheeseballs , which were absolutely delicious. And pull apart bread with two varieties of butter, which was OK nothing to brag about. But this is where everything  went downhill. When we placed our order for our appetizers, we also placed our order for our food so that the food can be brought out shortly after we finished our appetizers. We had a party of four and one dish came out for one of the people in our group about a half hour later, and we assumed that the food was still coming out to be served to the rest of us. Well, it didn’t happen and the person who got her food wasn’t gonna eat by herself so her food just got cold. About 45 minutes has gone by since we finished our appetizers and still nothing came out so we finally got the manager‘s attention and without even saying anything, he already knew what was going on by looking at our table. He apologized and said that this should’ve never have happened and basically went back to the chef. ￼ So we waited another 20 to 25 minutes for our food to come out finally. While all this was happening we barely saw our server . She was pleasant to talk to, but didn’t really fulfill our needs of even being around to see if everything was OK. All in all after waiting almost an hour to an hour and 15 minutes for food you kind of lose that appetite with all the frustration that you’re experiencing. Food was good, but I couldn’t say that it was overwhelmingly good because of the loss of appetite from the frustration and waiting ￼. The general manager said that he’d take care of things and make things right, but that wasn’t really disclosed to us what they were doing to do so. When we got our check, 25% discount was taken off, which was nice of them to do but once again was it worth the experience? Won’t be coming back here.
reviews.author: GIUSEPPE

reviews.text: Lauren our server was wonderful! Beautiful restaurant as well.
reviews.author: Alyssa

reviews.text: Five stars all around! The food at Wolf by Vanderpump is top-tier, but what really sets them apart is the service. The staff goes above and beyond to make sure you're taken care of.  While there are many restaurants in Scottsdale, there are literally a handful that can meet exceptional food and service.  Scottsdale finally has a restaurant that reaches the standard of many restaurants in New York City.  Wolf is a must-visit if you’re in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Tamara

reviews.text: First time at the Wolf. Great experience, except for the hostesses who can loosen up a little bit and become more friendly, genuinely friendly, it’s Scottsdale 🤷🏼‍♀️
reviews.author: Irina

reviews.text:
Horrible experience wanted sweet ice tea and got regular ice tea had to argue with the waiter that we had regular ice tea then he finally came back and said that we were right

Had the cobbler for dessert and the topping was literally burnt and looked black it tasted like charcoal could not even eat it if I recall I was charged for it

Simply not a great experience and we were celebrating my nieces birthday so made it embarrassing for me since I choose your restaurant
reviews.author: Cathleen

reviews.text: It was amazing experience!! The table was beautiful and incredible service! Thank you very much!
reviews.author: Svetlana

reviews.text: Amazing food, drinks and service!! Highly recommend!!
reviews.author: Andrea

reviews.text: They got us right in at our reservation time seated us at a two top in the bar. Our server was terrific, friendly, outgoing, personable, and attentive. The drinks were fun and colorful. The view of Camelback Mountain was amazing and because the weather is nice the doors were open they have an indoor outdoor vibe
reviews.author: Brent

reviews.text: Good for drinks and 1 or two apps but that’s it, menu is not worth the price. $32 for chips and dip is insane even for Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Tessa

reviews.text:
Possibly one of the most beautiful restaurants I have ever been to! I’d expect nothing less from Lisa Vanderpump! The ambience is off the charts!

The service was not at all what I’d expect from a fine dining restaurant. Average at best, felt like our server was bothered by our presence. We’re a very low maintenance group and spent over $600.  I’d expect service to be a little more elevated.

Food was very good. Goat cheese balls were yummy but had to ask for more sauce. I had sea bass and it was very good.

All in all a good experience. Will definitely give it another try and hope for a better service experience.
reviews.author: Marla

reviews.text: This was my third time and thankfully management must have finally read all of the reviews because the service was so much better. The first two times we got nice servers but it took them 30 minutes to bring our drinks (when the restaurant was empty) and were not attentive throughout our dinner at all. We had to get the manager because the servers disappeared. The food in this last visit was excellent - we shared the goat cheese balls, ahi appetizer and sliders and all were delicious.
reviews.author: Maria

reviews.text: Loved the atmosphere and the service. Drinks and appetizers were great. The only thing that threw me off was the uncomfortable seating. There were plenty of supportive seating options  as the restaurant was not full when we went, however we were seated in a space that had low backless round chairs and one booth seat. Out of respect I let my friend sit on the side that was booth style, but let me tell you I was in such discomfort midway through our experience.  I am in good shape and have never had a back issues before so this was truly due to the seating. Very cute chairs for sure, but not comfortable to dine in- I can’t imagine how someone prone to back issues would feel. Next time, I’d request a different seating arrangement.
reviews.author: Erica

reviews.text: I tried this place with a friend. I had a pasta dish recommended by the server because pasta was made in-house and it was excellent. My friend thought his food was mediocre and sent back a side dish, although to be fair this friend is a bit critical. Decor was a bit over the top. Server was friendly and knowledgeable. Food came to a bit over $50 per person with tip and without alcohol. Overall, good, not great, when I compare to similarly priced restaurants in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Richard

reviews.text: We'll start with the good. The ambiance is awesome, from the decor of the restaurant to the views out the windows, 5 stars for sure. The staff were very friendly and attentive, maybe too attentive. On 3 occasions someone (different staff) tried to clear our silverware (including brand new knives delivered to us specifically for upcoming entrees) from the table thinking we were done, but we had not had not eaten yet. Where we were seated, my husband had the sun in his eyes. The shades were halfway down but the sun caused a glare on an adjacent table which reflected into my husband's eyes.  Server asked host to lower shades more, but shades could not be lowered.  So my husband was blinded for about 15 minutes until the sun changed angle. 4 stars for service.  Now the food. The primary reason you go to a restaurant.  We give it only 2 stars.  It was edible, but not enjoyable. We started with Caviar and potato chips.  That was good, 4 stars. Took off a star because I think they could have given more Crème Fraîche to accompany the chips, we ran out half way through the chips.   My husband had the beet salad, nothing special about it, 2 stars. I had the caesar salad, 2 stars. It needed more dressing. I don't by any means like my lettuce soaked in dressing, but this was really skimpy.  We got the chilean seabass which was disappointing, 2 stars.  Tasted like regular seabass, not chilean. It was very meaty.  Also got the Ribeye.  Just Fair, 2 stars.  We thought it lacked flavor.  They did give my husband a brownie with scoop of icecream (and a card) for his bday, which was a nice touch.  Their mocktail selection needs work (add Seedlip or Ritual), not just juice mixtures.  All in all, we enjoyed the evening, because it's always nice to try someplace new and the ambiance was awesome.  But the food was just fair and with the prices they charge, I expect better tasting food.  We might give them another try in another year or 2, but won't plan on visiting again anytime soon.
reviews.author: Nicole

reviews.text: Amazing, food was delicious. Had the goat cheese balls…as good as we had hoped! Service was wonderful!! So beautiful, loved every minute.
reviews.author: Jackie

reviews.text:
The environment was very upscale and unique.  Beautiful view looking east toward Camelback Mountain.  It is set up so the large windows can be open or closed depending on the weather.  It is very unique for Phoenix/Scottsdale, with nice chandeliers and a mixture of tables, chairs and stools throughout.  Very nice.

I ordered the Halibut and fries and was disappointed.  The two pieces of fresh fish were large but overcooked.  There was only enough tartar sauce for one fish.  The French fries were excellent, but they didn't bring any ketchup.  I asked the waitress for more, but she never brought them back.  The peas were tasty, but the dish they were served in was tiny, and every time I put my fork in it, the peas would spill out.  I was lucky to get two peas on my fork at a time.  My girlfriend had the risotto, which she liked.

The waitress was nice, but was seldom around.

The noise level was very high, making conversation difficult.

We are not alcoholic drinkers, but the drinks looked interesting and unique, and seemed pricey.

Overall, I would go again and try something else to eat, because I like the atmosphere/ambiance, and they deserve a second chance.
reviews.author: CHARLES

reviews.text: Had a reservation at 8:30 and didn’t get seated until around 9:30. Our bar drinks took 20 minutes and the service overall wasn’t great. The service was horrible and forgot to get all of the items we asked her for (3). Would not go back
reviews.author: Jackie

reviews.text: Overall, the staff was amazing. The food was great. I will be returning soon. ￼
reviews.author: Liza

reviews.text: We had our galantines dinner at the wolf. After hearing some mix reviews about the place, we were going in without any expectations. Everything we ordered, except for one drink, was great! The ambiance was so pretty and service was good. Will be back with my husband in the future!
reviews.author: Jamie

reviews.text: Such an awesome vibe, really amazing view, good service, and price point was very fair in considering location and view.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We LOVED our server Amy (if I remember correctly). She is from OH.   She was enthusiastic, attentive and knowledgeable.  Great time!
reviews.author: Elsa

reviews.text: Absolutely gorgeous place and every thing was perfect. Food was delicious and the service was flawless. Had a lovely time celebrating a friends birthday
reviews.author: Jessica

reviews.text: Ambiance was wonderful, really felt unique to Scottsdale where a high end lodge meets sophisticated glamor. High energy vibe. Service was excellent. I don’t mind paying for high end food but although inventive felt the flavors fell flat. However I would definitely recommend and go back.  Lastly I wish the dress code was enforced, especially for the men.
reviews.author: Tammy

reviews.text: Great ambiance and energy! The decor is insane in the best way. The food is good but that’s not why you go. Our server Nicole was a hard worker - very upbeat and friendly.
reviews.author: Melissa

reviews.text: Our experience was great! Fish portion could have been better.
reviews.author: Jammie

reviews.text: Lived up to the hype - great vibe, good food and excellent people watching
reviews.author: Veena

reviews.text:
Incredibly impressed…

I thought it would be a place with a lot of razzle dazzle and mid food. I was wrong…

Everything we ordered was SO good.

The staff was so well trained, the ambience was unique and the food was so tasty with every dish we tried.

We all were so surprised.

Definitely go-
reviews.author: Nicole

reviews.text: We had an amazing time here, the drinks were amazing and they came out quick. The staff was super kind to us!
reviews.author: Raechel

reviews.text: It was just average. We loved our meal in Tahoe and this didn't meet the standard. The drinks and bread were good but nothing else was great. Service was lacking.
reviews.author: Jennifer

reviews.text: There was 5 of us celebrating a birthday. Was impressed with the charcuterie and wings. Some of the best I have had. My Cocktail was great. And the shot package was nice too. The bill was just under  700 with tip. So expect a bit over 100 per person if having alcohol. I was just disappointed with service. I had to chase the wait staff down. Multiple times. To get another round. Or to get the check. We had sat there with plates/drinks empty for well over 20 min. Finally I asked someone else if they could send someone with the check.
reviews.author: Ashley

reviews.text: Such a great vibe. Very fun and chic and the waitresses were very attentive and nice.
reviews.author: Laura

reviews.text: Thank you Sia for your lovely service, my daughter and I had a wonderful experience. The food was beyond amazing and the drinks were perfect. Will be definitely returning. Thank you.
reviews.author: Sonia

reviews.text:
3 stars is generous. I would say more like 2.5. The 2.5 goes towards the ambiance. It’s a beautiful restaurant. That’s where the fun ended for us.
Service was terrible. It was so slow that our food came before our drinks. The goat cheese balls tasted like cream cheese. No sign of goat cheese. We ordered the beet salad with dressing on the side. (Beautiful presentation but missed the mark on taste). It came drenched in dressing. We told the server but she just shrugged it off. My friends ordered the sliders, the shrimp tacos and some truffle fries. I ordered the chicken. They said the sliders and tacos were fine. Their fries were cold and they could not taste truffle. My chicken was so overly salted that it was inedible. I let the server know and she said she would let the chef know. No one ever came out to apologize or offer to make it right. I was charged for something I could not eat.  (I would have taken one properly seasoned to go). Clearly the waitstaff is not well trained.
Drinks were good once we got them. I would sit at the bar and have drinks but I would not dine there. They have had enough time to work out the kinks so I’m assuming this is the best they can do. Too bad.
reviews.author: Melissa

reviews.text: FAB - YOU - LOUS!!!  WHAT AN EXPERIENCE!!!  THE DECOR, THE FOOD, THE SERVICE — TOPS!!!  And absolutely elegant,
reviews.author: Jane

reviews.text: The restaurant is beautiful. Vibes are 10/10. Lighting and music was off- not sure why we were listening to the Trolls soundtrack? Drinks were too expensive to be mediocre. There was more garnish on the drinks than actual drink. We were also seated in a very dark corner (at 4pm and the place was empty) next to where all the servers congregated & they had their server meeting. Bright side-the server drama was very VPR.
reviews.author: Kaila

reviews.text: Our  monthly luncheon group met here since it was a new restaurant.  The food was excellent, however, they were certainly short staffed. It took forever to get menus, get our order in, get our bill, etc. two of us had the jumbo shrimp tacos, and, they were yummy , another had the salmon with vegetables and it was very good, Another had the burger and she said it was great, one had the chicken wrap. She said it was just OK.
reviews.author: Shirley

reviews.text: Asked four time for catsup and finally about 15 minutes later got some.  Burger was Luke warm.  It was like eating in the middle of a dance club floor the music was so loud.  Our open table $40 reward card would not open properly, manager couldn't have cared less even after showing him that we had it on phone.  Overpriced, noisy, and we won't be back.
reviews.author: JERRY

reviews.text: I have been to several of Lisa’s restaurants and fell in love with this one. Their staff was incredible. Best service I’ve had in such a long time. The food was perfect as well as the timing. Thanks for a GREAT dinner with the girls. Will forever come back.
reviews.author: Carissa

reviews.text: We ordered a bottle of champagne and the server brought it out and poured it. The wine was HOT. Not kinda of warm but hot. They didn’t have any other champagnes from the wine list cold which is wild, other than Moet which was sweet and not what we wanted to drink. Just seemed very novice and not great.
reviews.author: Cassie

reviews.text: The atmosphere was amazing and the decor was like no other. Was disappointed that we were told they were out of the bread and then after our food came everyone around us was getting bread and then we were told our waitstaff was incorrect. Guess I’ll have to go back
reviews.author: Lisa

reviews.text: ORDER THE BREAD! You won't be disappointed. Absolutely delicious!
reviews.author: Ann

reviews.text: Our server was awesome! She always made sure we had a smile on!
reviews.author: Tanya

reviews.text: The restaurant was lovely but because it was a busy weekend the kitchen was so backed up along with being out of a lot of items- I will be back once the kinks are worked out but it’s a great vibe for sure! Sarah was an amazing server and I felt so bad because everything was out of her control. They comped our food because it took over an hour to receive but if you’re with good company and there to enjoy the scenery then it’s great!
reviews.author: hailee

reviews.text: Waiting almost an hour to get seated. No drinks or complimentary appetizers was offered for the delay. We watched other Caucasian guests get offered champagne for the delay. I actually had to ask for it and we were handed the glasses as we were walking to our table. The salmon dish was dry and the salad was wilted; the server forgot to pick it up timely. The whole experience was horrible. I will not be returning. Concerns were expressed to the server.
reviews.author: Pat

reviews.text:
We made a reservation three weeks in advance. The reservation was for 7:30 PM. We arrived at 7:00 PM knowing that we were early and would likely go to the rooftop for a drink ahead of dinner. This was for our one year wedding anniversary. When we arrived, the host informed us that our reservation would more than likely not be seated on time, even arriving 30 minutes early we would still be seated late. We headed to the rooftop, where the glass of wine I purchased was a 5 ounce pour for $17, in a clear plastic solo cup. My husband ordered a beer, the bartender let him know that it would be warm because they did not have a working refrigerator. When we asked if there were beer options that were cold, he replied no.
We returned to the host stand at 7:30 PM, and again we’re told we would be seated late. We were seated at 7:50 PM. The table we were sat at was nice, next to a window, and had a good view. The server was excellent, and attentive. She did give us a free shot for our wedding anniversary. The goat cheese balls were dry and there was no side or sauce to pair with it. I will say the Vanderpump Cabernet was good. I got a burger, which was delicious. My husband got the fish and chips. We ordered the appetizer and food at the same time. After about 30 minutes past receiving our appetizer, our server came to our table to inform us the fish, for the fish and chips, was being thawed which is why our entrée was taking so long. They did comp the meal, which was very generous. However, at a five star restaurant owned by Lisa Vanderpump, I was shocked to hear she was serving frozen fish. We did not get dessert. Overall, I would give the experience a two out of five stars, the ambience of course was beautiful, but aside from our server, the service was below average, the food was average, and the experience overall was disappointing.
reviews.author: Samantha

reviews.text: Super cool & hip vibe. The drinks were fantastic, the food was amazing and the atmosphere was sleek. Rich, who was behind the bars was fun and made the most incredible cocktails. The only complaint we had was that they were out of several food options that we would have loved to order. A restaurant of this caliber should not be running out of food when the menu is already a bit limited.
reviews.author: Rebecca

reviews.text:
Fantastic experience! The restaurant is drop dead gorgeous, including the bar and all of the beautiful lighting fixtures.

Grace was our server and she was super friendly, provided great recommendations, and was an attentive!

The shrimp cocktail were delicious! They were HUGE! And they clean the shrimp!

The food and drinks came out quickly!

The entire experience is very positive. I would highly recommend it!
reviews.author: Josh

reviews.text: We had a reservation for 6:45pm, that was reserved weeks before the date. We waited over 45 minutes to be seated. I thought that was the point of reservations, to avoid that situation. The waitress was amazing however.
reviews.author: Nick

reviews.text: Overall a fun atmosphere. Though we waited 45minutes past our reservation time which was annoying. They should have at least given us a free drink or bread? And when we were seated they said they were out of 3 items on the menu.
reviews.author: Stephanie

reviews.text: Meh. Meh. Meh. Our server was delightful but that is where the compliments stop. 1 1/2hrs to get appetizer’s and then salads and entrees 5 minutes later and all at once. Food was ok, just ok not knock my socks off. Dessert was served in a skillet and was supposed to be hot- it was ice cold. Cocktails were fun and delicious so a bright spot in an otherwise meh evening. Will we go back , probably not. Might consider a cocktail and a sunset before leaving for a better dinning experience.
reviews.author: Natalie

reviews.text: Had a reservation at 6, didn’t get seated til 640. Most of the items weren’t available and when we got the food, it was cold
reviews.author: Jacklyn

reviews.text: Food was very bland. Expected way more for the price point.
reviews.author: Sam

reviews.text: The service and manager were great!!!  The ambiance was great!!!! The views are great!!!  Thats it!!!  The food was sooo disappointing!!!   We did not try one thing that we felt we would need to return for.  There are so many great restaurants in Scottsdale and this is not one of them!!!
reviews.author: Kate

reviews.text: Choked on how dry the goat cheese balls were, lobster tacos tasted more like the toppings rather than lobster, and the sliders were just “meh”. Cocktails were unbalanced and had too much sugar. Server was ok, and the ambiance was what I would expect. Over all, not impressed.
reviews.author: Rob

reviews.text: We went with a friend for her birthday and we had an amazing meal and celebration. Food portions were generous and reasonably priced. Everything we had was delicious. They have fun coctails and the view is incredible. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Lisa

reviews.text:
Last night we visited Wolf by Vanderpump at Caesars Republic Scottsdale, and I must say the ambiance is truly spectacular. The décor, glamour, and overall vibe create a beautiful and visually impressive experience. The prices are appropriate for the concept and level of the restaurant, and the check-in process was quick and well organized.

The food was delicious; however, the variety was quite limited. On several occasions we tried to order items listed on the menu that were not available. It might be a good idea to adjust the menu to reflect only what is actually in stock to avoid confusion and unmet expectations.

Unfortunately, the weakest part of the evening was the service. The person attending us was not attentive; several times we were left speaking while being told “one minute,” only for them to return much later to continue the service. We felt a lack of engagement and interest during our dining experience. We are not sure if it was stress or frustration while explaining the dishes we were considering, but the interaction did not feel welcoming. Additionally, one of the drinks I ordered never arrived with the smoke presentation as described.

We also informed the restaurant in advance that we were celebrating our wedding anniversary and chose this location specifically to enjoy such a special occasion. However, there was no courtesy or acknowledgment from the restaurant. While not mandatory, a small gesture would have been a thoughtful touch considering the significance of the night and our decision to celebrate there.

The restaurant has everything it needs to provide a five-star experience, but the service and attention to detail definitely need improvement to match the atmosphere and quality of the food.
The most disappointing part of the night was the “lobster” my wife ordered. It turned out not to be a lobster entrée at all, but what looked like miniature lobster tacos. It was honestly almost laughable — and in fact, we all laughed when we saw the tin
reviews.author: Libny Raúl

reviews.text: This was our second time to Wolf (this past Valentine's Day and it was JUST as amazing as the first night we dined here. Possibly even better!!! This is definitely our new date spot for sure. 😍😁
reviews.author: Ashley

reviews.text: horrible service and food, waited 35 min to be seated for our Anniversary, was not acknowledged for our celebration and was rarley attended
reviews.author: gael

reviews.text: from the time we got to Wolf the front staff greeted us with a rose and complimentary champagne for valentine’s day. from the time we sat the ambience was amazing and the service made it that much better. will for sure be back!
reviews.author: Nicolette

reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant with a wide variety of food selections. Elegantly designed at a very desirable location in Scottsdale. It has the perfect Vanderpump touch. We went on Valentine’s Day and were given 2 free glasses of champagne and a rose upon entrance. The food was unbelievably good, they were accommodating about a severe nut allergy, and service was good (which says a lot given it was VDAY). I’ll definitely be coming back!
reviews.author: Sierra

reviews.text: This was my 5th LVP restaurant I’ve been to and it did not disappoint.
reviews.author: Danielle

reviews.text:
Upon arriving, we noticed this is the old place Seven. We attended on Valentine’s Day and I see all the ladies around me have flowers. I didn’t receive one. (Wife writing review) whatever brushed it off. Drinks were ok I got the Peter rabbit didn’t have so much flavor. We got the chips and dip and we had raw veggies of cauliflower at least make it pickled.  The only delicious part of apps was the sliders. They were tasteful.  Ordered little gem Caesar and ribeye because I like the flavor and my steak was ok. Husband got the filet and didn’t have much flavor
Like a typical top grade filet. Our steaks took so long to come. We even asked what’s taking so long she said because it’s medium well it takes longer…..what?? Anywho ate some steak and the sides and was not impressed at all. We def won’t be coming back.
reviews.author: Steve

reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of dining at Wolf by Vanderpump, and I must say, it was an incredible experience. The food was amazingly delicious – each dish was bursting with flavor and beautifully presented. Our server, Nicole, was exceptional; she was attentive, friendly, and truly made our dining experience memorable. The restaurant's atmosphere complemented the meal perfectly, creating a fantastic setting for a night out. I highly recommend Wolf by Vanderpump for anyone looking for a great meal in a vibrant environment!
reviews.author: Robert

reviews.text: Honestly, the food is delish. The service is great. The food comes out fast. I truly can’t complain.
reviews.author: Brittany

reviews.text: Waiter was absolutely garbage. No personality. Took our drink order and screwed it up. Took our food order.  Made no suggestions. Brought us the check. That was all we saw of him. So bad I was going to tell a manger but decided to just ignore it.
reviews.author: Kelly

reviews.text: The Goat Cheeseballs lived up to the hype but the Wolf Bread was delicious along with the spreads it came with. We will definitely be back to try the dinner menu!
reviews.author: Christian

reviews.text: This was the worst restaurant I have ever been to. I do food influencing in the Scottsdale area and If I could give it negative stars I would. We dined here for a total of an hour and a half on Valentines Day and only received our drinks within the last 5 minutes we were there with lipstick already on the cup. Gross. During that time, we also received only 2 appetizers that were wrong. My boyfriend is celiac and we were told we would receive the tuna tartare without the tostada and received them with it. We then asked them to just box the rest of the food we ordered at this point and paid to leave, just for us to wait another 20 minutes, not receive our other entree, and received the wings I ordered without anything on them. I’m so disappointed because I was so excited to try this restaurant just to receive horrible service.
reviews.author: Erika

reviews.text: It was Valentines day and it was pretty busy but all of the staff was very friendly and attentive. The food was good for a late lunch. We would recommend the beet salad and add steak, crab hushpuppies, and tuna tostadas the chicken Cobb salad was huge and the chocolate brownie was warm and yummy.
reviews.author: Jynchelle

reviews.text: Food ambience the staff all incredible! The goat cheese balls are out of this world!
reviews.author: Elena

reviews.text: Over all great experience.  Loved the decor.  Food was okay. Service was decent.  Drink prices were high - food prices at lunch are reasonable.
reviews.author: KIMBERLY

reviews.text: The restaurant is gorgeous but unfortunately the food and service were mediocre at best. Server was gracious but restaurant seemed under staffed.
reviews.author: Bernadette

reviews.text: Loved it ! Food was great service was awesome 👏🏼 definitely will come back :)
reviews.author: Rubi

reviews.text: Very good food great service, made reservations for 8:15 didn’t seat until almost 9, food takes about an hour to come out once placed.
reviews.author: Haleigh

reviews.text: Great experience, food was amazing and the roof top bar with live music was an unexpected treat.
reviews.author: Michael

reviews.text: Absolutely an amazing time!  All the food and drinks were perfect
reviews.author: Angeline

reviews.text: Great experience. Reservation was over 30 minutes late. But food and drinks made up for it
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.text: Everything was fantastic. The restaurant is immaculate and beautiful, all the food was perfect… And Anna was a great server… We will request her again… We will be back with friends soon!￼
reviews.author: Lyle

reviews.text: The service was amazing and the food was magical!
reviews.author: Sheyanne

reviews.text: The atmosphere was memorable and the food so very delicious! I will definitely go back!
reviews.author: Ronda

reviews.text: Des and Sarah were the best! Service was great, and loved all the different options of drinks. View was spectacular, would definitely come back again
reviews.author: Brooklyn

reviews.text: food was okay compared to other VPR locations. we also had to wait 30 min for our reservation…
reviews.author: Olivia

reviews.text: This restaurant is beautiful design wise. Gorgeous view of camel back . Great crowd and good people watching. Food is good. Love the variety on the menu. Wouldn’t recommend for kids. It’s a grown up place. Last but not least was our server. Her name was Emily, the sweetest, most polite and very well trained and professional . She made our night memorable. Tnx .
reviews.author: Soheila

reviews.text: Food was good but not outstanding. So many amazing restaurants in AZ with better food. Amy our waitress was awesome. Ambience is beautiful.
reviews.author: Monica

reviews.text: Second experience at Wolf.  Staff could not be more accommodating.  Food was wonderful.
reviews.author: Susan

reviews.text: The views and the decor are incredible!!  Service was very good.  Cocktails were delicious.  We had the fried goat cheese balls ( yum ), roasted beet salad and the Wolf Burger.  All were prepared perfectly and were very tasty.  Great spot for cocktails and nibbles — especially around sunset.
reviews.author: Nancy

reviews.text: Overall it was a good experience. The decor and ambiance is just beautiful. The drinks are done so well that the food almost becomes an after thought…meaning the food isn’t as memorable. But that’s not to say I wouldn’t go back. It’s a total vibe, a hot spot, and everyone should experience a sunset like this spot can offer.!
reviews.author: Stephanie

reviews.text: The staff were all very friendly and efficient. They made us feel at-home welcome! The food was beyond excellent and that view of the mountains was breathtaking. Total Scottsdale bragging rights as I had an out-of-town guest with me.
reviews.author: Stephen

reviews.text: Our server was fantastic food was excellent, did take longer than expected to be seated
reviews.author: Darrin

reviews.text:
The food was subpar. Here is what we ordered.
LOBSTER CEVICHE CRISPS was a mushy mini taco and not warm.
SMOKED COWBOY WINGS were cold and table side smoke was not longer when delivered. 
6oz PRIME FILET MIGNON was tasty but cold
TRUFFLE FRIES also cold and soggy. Something was hard and almost cracked a tooth.
HOUSEMADE CHOCOLATE BROWNIE was bland but they did put a candle in for bday- in cream tasted like chemicals
STONEFRUIT COBBLER tasted like cough syrup, tumeric and pepper-sent back for a brownie no ice cream. Service said they changed the recipe and the previous one was better.

Servicer was sweet and kind, but didn't see her much. Drinks took along time, tables not cleared timely, and expensive with poor food. Wonder how long it will survive in Scottsdale with so many better options for the money and experience. Decor was meh compared to other places in Scottsdale. Instagram location due to the name not anything else. We all left hungry. Reservation is for 2 hours where you want to leave earlier or not due to he length of time drinks and food come out.
reviews.author: Laurie

reviews.text: Terrible service!! We made a reservation for 7pm and weren’t seated until 7:45pm. Manager kept saying he was going to “make things right”. We never saw him again once we were seated. Service was slow. We don’t get first round of drinks until 8:15pm. Food was okay. Hostesses weren’t attentive. Would not recommend.
reviews.author: Jackie

reviews.text: Great overall dining experience, drinks and food was amazing
reviews.author: Art

reviews.text: Food was amazing! Best salmon and zucchini we’ve ever eaten! Drinks were also perfect! Waiter was marginal. We were seated in the bar area near the kitchen. Not given an option for another area. Way too busy of a table.
reviews.author: Mark

reviews.text: Way too loud. It felt like I needed earplugs and couldn’t even talk to the person sitting next to me. The people at tables near us were literally screaming at each other. And no I’m not old. Will not return ￼
reviews.author: bart

reviews.text: Ordered sliders - tartare and goat cheese balls - these item were fine - sea bass was fishy - rubbery and greasy - it got sent back - stone fruit dessert had peach pits in it and the top was burnt - the smashed fingerlings were mostly skin - some of the dishes came out cool instead of hot - if it wasn’t for our waitress who was phenomenal,we probably would have left mid meal - the fixtures in the women’s bathroom stall were also falling out of the wall and the odd looking mop pads on the sink were less than appealing - was there a rush to open this restaurant? It had a lot of potential so I am not sure what went wrong - but it was definitely a disappointment
reviews.author: melissa

reviews.text: The food was awful.  In our group of 7 nobody liked their meal.  The table was not set.  We had to ask for silverware, plates and napkin always after the food arrived.  The service was very inattentive. This place was not worth it!!!!
reviews.author: carol

reviews.text:
The dining room is fun, funky and unique.  Our waitress, Amy, was wonderful, informative and so willing to please.
Located on the 7th top floor the views of sunset were amazing and the windows were open so it was breezy.  We sampled many dishes and for those who like fried foods this menu will not disappoint.  For those of us who prefer healthier options, this menu may leave you frustrated.  Most of the food is deep fried with cheeses abounding.
The Caesar salad was too cheesy and some of the lettuce was brown.  The crab and corn hush puppies were excellent as was the signature bread.  The haddock and chips was enough to share but the haddock was not moist.  The wagyu sliders and shrimp cocktail was truly enjoyed.  The alcoholic beverages were excellent.  The noise level at 5 pm when we arrived was pleasant but by 7 pm we had to leave because we were exhausted from trying to converse with the people at our table.  Loud noise levels seem to be a trend at most new restaurants now and it’s getting old.  This place is definitely worth a try and we wish the proprietors much success.  It’s a welcome addition to Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Marianne

reviews.text:
We celebrated our 19th wedding anniversary here and it was such a great experience! We started off with a Pinot Grigio and the goat cheese balls — absolutely amazing (a little messy, but totally worth it!). We also ordered the lobster hush puppies, and they were incredible.

For our entrées, we had the prime rib and the baked chicken. Both were delicious and cooked perfectly. Our main meal did take a little longer than expected, but the manager, Parker, came by to check on us and chat, which we really appreciated.

The ambience is on point, and our server, Hanna, was top notch! Overall, such a wonderful place to celebrate a special occasion.
reviews.author: Angelica

reviews.text: What an Amazing experience. Everything about this place was fantastic.
reviews.author: Tom

reviews.text: Really didn’t expect much thinking that it was a housewives of Beverly Hills establishment. I have been to other Lisa Vanderpump restaurants. I would say first of all the interior design is first rate absolutely gorgeous. Great for date night top 10 on that ! I think they’re just getting started so a little bit slow on service but Rebecca being a new server was great. The food was also very good and the wine list exceptional. I would rate this a five out of five thank you for a lovely evening. We will certainly return.
reviews.author: Karen

reviews.text: Everything was amazing! We came in to celebrate Galentines Day and had a great experience. Service was great! So many staff members acknowledged us and asked if we needed anything. The food was amazing, every dish was very flavorful. Ambiance was incredible from every little detail to the city views! 10/10
reviews.author: Melissa

reviews.text:
This was my 2nd visit. It was just a good as my first experience,  we ordered a couple different things off the menu this time. Including, the Bolognese, which was next level.

Highly recommended!! ￼
reviews.author: Gina

reviews.text:
Loved the atmosphere! I don't think they have enough staff to keep up with the number of customers.
Our cocktails took very long to get. Over 20 minutes and the martinis were not very cold and the old fashions were watered down from the ice cube melting. They must have sat too long at the bar. Food was very good. We had a table for 6. NOTE tip is included for group of 6. We did not get an itemized receipt, just the total. We asked the waitress if tip was already included, she said,"I think so." Would definitely go back but not for awhile. I think they need to get the kinks worked out.
reviews.author: Jodi

reviews.text: Service was horrible. Not sure if it was because we were a big party and so the gratuity was going to be added anyways or what but we rarely checked on. Got bread - no plates. Had to flag someone down to get plates. Empty old drinks were just left on the table the ENTIRE time - not cleared till we were leaving.
reviews.author: Crystal

reviews.text: I had a great experience everything about it was wonderful. The ambience was amazing. The food was very good and the service was the best I’ve had in a very long time.
reviews.author: Tomi

reviews.text: The entrance was stunning. Blake was great. All the food was great - desert nectar, best drink ever. They were out of the Wolf bread, so didn’t get to try that.
reviews.author: Katie

reviews.text: Amazing love this vibe , great staff , great views, great music
reviews.author: Jenny

reviews.text: Great time!!! Excellent food!! Outstanding service!
reviews.author: Rilie

reviews.text: Unless you want to be in the bar where it is dark and loud for your dining experience make sure you ask to be in the main dining room.  We had to be reseated because we couldn’t hear each other and it was so dark and loud. Cocktails were good, service was great.  Food was good.. not great.
reviews.author: Judi

reviews.text:
The hostesses were nice, but not helpful. Took 20 min to get seated after checking in (with a reservation early in the night.... on purpose to avoid that). Once seated, we sat for more than 5 min before anyone acknowledged we existed.

I'd heard the food was great and it didn't disappoint. Be warned, the chicken wings are great, but are covered in edible glitter lol

So, food,  GREAT! experience, poor especially considering the number of "vibe" restaurants in this town. We went once, likely won't again (similar to the Luna spot on the first floor of this hotel- one and done).
reviews.author: JENNIFER

reviews.text: Fun experience. Kelsey provided great attention and service.
reviews.author: Tracy

reviews.text: The vibe is definitely very Vanderpump, super cool! Food was good but not anything exceptional. If you’re wanting an amazing meal, this is definitely more about the aesthetic of the restaurant.
reviews.author: bailey

reviews.text: The restaurant is gorgeous. Great atmosphere. The music got better the later in the evening it got.  The views are amazing. The Service is top tier. The  food is ok. Not lip smacking, lick your fingers, I can’t wait for more, but it’s ok. It lacks flavor. I had the Chilean sea bass, the potatoes were greasy, and the whole dish needed salt. My favorite was the salted caramel desert drink. Otherwise, I would return for the vibes for sure.
reviews.author: Virginia

reviews.text:
Excellent service and wonderful food!
The detail to decor was outstanding and really was remarkable!
reviews.author: Megan

reviews.text:
Let’s start by acknowledging that they truly did the best they could with their resources! The food was outstanding—definitely five stars. I tried the Wolf burger and was delightfully surprised by how flavorful it was. The fries were also delicious, which is saying a lot since I'm not usually a fry person.

The hostess went above and beyond to get us seated. Since we were a party of 6 and had two small children, we initially thought outdoor seating would be ideal in case the kids became unruly. However, there wasn't really outdoor seating available, making it not the most kid-friendly spot. They also didn't have a children’s menu, even though the restaurant is located inside a hotel—an unexpected detail. Nonetheless, we made it work. We were celebrating my birthday and booked the 12:45 Saturday seating, aiming for an early time so the kids could join us.

We were surprised that there was no mention of the birthday celebration or a dessert menu, which would have been a nice touch.

It seemed like the restaurant was understaffed for such a busy weekend, especially with major events like the Waste Management golf tournament and Barrett Jackson auto auction taking place in town.

Our server did her best to accommodate us, and I was very satisfied with her effort. In the end, as I mentioned earlier, they truly did the best they could with what was available.

I’d like to give it another try in the future, hopefully they’ll get it figured out.
reviews.author: Frank

reviews.text:
Let me start with what it’s a beautiful place with gorgeous decor. Hover, food was mediocre  and few things we tried had so much burned oil what I only took a bite.  We finished our waters and no one stopped by to replenish them for an hour. They also  forgot what it was a birthday dinner and didn’t read it in the notes.
Every table on Friday night was full of 20 years old girls and I could count man on fingers of my hand. The main reason is what guys actually need a good food  and girls come to new pretty places as to the glorified tearoom.  Well, not sure if I will be back, probably for a drink at the bar and what’s about it.
reviews.author: christina

reviews.text: Wolf by Vanderpump was a good experience. The food was great, the drinks were okay (very sour), the service at first started off not great but got better as the night continued. Would definitely recommend to others but this is not somewhere I would go back to unless I was with a group that has not been before and they wanted to go.
reviews.author: Cheyenne

reviews.text: Amazing! Great food and even better service. We’ll be back for sure!
reviews.author: Kristynna

reviews.text: Outstanding experience! A little pricey but definitely worth it!
reviews.author: Robin

reviews.text: The restaurant is beautifully done and I would expect that from Lisa as I am a fan of hers from HWBH and V.Rules.  The only thing I did not like was looking at the pool and people sunbathing.  It would have been nice to have a full patio of seating. Lunch menu good.   I will be going back on Feb 20 for dinner.
reviews.author: Dianna

reviews.text: Great experience. Staff very friendly and accommodating. Food was exceptional.
reviews.author: Kristy

reviews.text: Don’t select outdoor seating it’s more like pool seating. Order the dirty dog martini
reviews.author: Lisa

reviews.text: Food and drinks was fantastic. Friendly staff. The views are breathtaking!! Highly recommended!!
reviews.author: Jessica

reviews.text: Top notch services!! We were early for our reservation and were able to be seated right away. The hospitality was amazing. The food quality was so much better than the Tahoe location; everything tasted fresh.
reviews.author: Alison

reviews.text: A great experience all around! Highly recommend!!!
reviews.author: Monique

reviews.text: Our waitress was so great! Such a fun vibe with great food. The ribeye was amazing!
reviews.author: Kim

reviews.text: I cant express how impressed I was with the entire experience. The staff, food, cocktails, timing of service, views... I could really go on for hours. We ordered the goat cheese balls, lobster ceviche, pork tomahawk, and it was all amazing but my only feedback is that the pork needed more seasoning but it was still perfectly cooked, paired with a delicious chimichurri and roasted vegetables. Cant wait to come back!
reviews.author: Jessica

reviews.text: Obviously, this restaurant is the place to be. We went on a Monday night and was much more fun than expected! The food was phenomenal the drinks, the ambience and of course the service was superb.
reviews.author: Graham and Paulette

reviews.text:
Been here 2x since opening, sat at bar once, dining room another time !    It’s a very beautiful place inside & out , and for the record I wanna love this place , but I don’t !
First off it’s super loud , could not hear the voices of my friends at the same table.   My wife ordered chicken & it was dry !   Dry chicken at a nice restaurant is a crime ( the chef should be ashamed)  & my sea bass was dry , very disappointed!
Lots of super options in that very neighborhood, probably not returning !  With so much regret :(
reviews.author: Scott

reviews.text: Great spot, beautifully decorated.  The cocktails are so creative and apps were decent.
reviews.author: Jinx

reviews.text:
Food was just ok and very, very heavy on the garlic (which is not necessarily a bad thing, but it was definitely the dominant flavor). There were four of us in our party and others at the table also remarked on how heavy the garlic flavor was, even though we all had different items. The overall service was not great at all: the hostess staff was unfriendly and not welcoming, and once we were seated table service was very slow. We were there for about 90 minutes overall, and there was very little attention given to our table during that time, with everything (from water to beverages to meal) taking a very long time. Near the end of the meal, the waiter did finally come over to ask if there was anything else we needed, and although literally all of our drink glasses (water, soda, ice tea) were completely empty, and had been empty for some time, we had to point that out to him and specifically ask for drink refills. 

The lunch menu was also pretty limited and had a handful of items to choose from. We were there for a business lunch, and one of our colleagues has a gluten allergy and had a hard time figuring out what they could order. The waiter seemed very new, and had to refer to a printed GF cheat sheet, which was fine but then almost nothing on it was available on the lunch menu (I'm assuming items were from the dinner menu?) There were also quite a few things on the lunch menu that seemed like they should be listed on the GF menu (like the beet and burrata salad, which has absolutely nothing in the description that could possibly contain gluten) but they were not included, and our colleague ended up going with the only thing on the lunch menu that was on the list as GF, which was the caesar salad. They said it was not bad, just your basic caesar.

Overall it was not a terrible lunch or experience, just not one that would make me want to return.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: They were out of goat cheese balls and I got shrimp tacos which were fine but it was just fried shrimp with slaw and it was completely undressed, not even a squeeze of lime.  So it definitely could have been better.  We also got the pumptini which was good.  The mocktail was just okay, not worth the price and though.  The burger was also under seasoned.
reviews.author: Mia

reviews.text:
my wife and I enjoyed only one of the appetizers that we had intended to try. Reason: we got no attention from our server for 55 minutes after our order was placed, before we were told that there was a delay in the kitchen receiving our order. We only got to enjoy their famous Gruyere bread, two beverages, tuna tartare, and lobster ceviche crisps due to almost an hour delay in getting our appetizers and the lateness of the hour given, our reservations were at 7:30.  Consequently,
we decided not to order any entrées. The manager did approach us with apologies for the delay and did not charge us. We were very disappointed that we did not have the opportunity to enjoy some of the delicious appearing entrées on the menu. Perhaps or perhaps not we may go again at an earlier hour in the day￼￼. ruined what we expected to be a delightful treat and enjoyable evening.
reviews.author: rudolph

reviews.text: They were out of the goat cheese balls and two other items in the menu. That’s ok that happens.  But from past reviews it seems to happen more than it should.  Beautiful restaurant.  Server was attentive but the systems around her fell short.   Bussers would clear plates and food runners bring the dishes. But no silverware cause busser took them after the apps.  Wine list  needs serious expansion. They just need to work on a few things and I’m sure it will get better.  Not sure if I will return anytime soon.
reviews.author: Brad

reviews.text: Food was delicious, server was very friendly but a bit forgetful.  Ran out of several menu items by 7:15pm but we enjoyed the food we did order and the ambiance was just fabulous.
reviews.author: STACEY

reviews.text:
Had such a fun night at Love Wolf… it’s one of those places that just hits all the right notes.

The food is so good—really well done without feeling over the top—and the pricing sits in that perfect middle where you feel like you’re getting something special without it being a whole production.

The space is beautiful and a little fancy, but still relaxed… great energy, great atmosphere, and always a good time when we go.

One of those spots you just keep coming back to.
reviews.author: Troy

reviews.text: The music was too loud I could not talk to my table of people. Furniture not comfortable. Big legs on table one foot on floor one on the wood post. Then big un comfortable chair at the end of the table. I would not go back. We couldn't even talk.... disapointed. Didn't love the menu.
reviews.author: Jill

reviews.text: Waited 15 minutes after being sat for water and wait staff.  530 reservation and out of goat cheese balls. Decor is cheap and cheesy. Menu doesn’t make sense.
reviews.author: Todd

reviews.text: delicious food - great service - only thing is we went to the rooftop bar and ordered drinks that are also available in the restaurant and they drinks were premade which feels a little cheap considering drink prices. Not sure if drinks are also premade in the restaurant.
reviews.author: Erica

reviews.text: We had a great time dining at Wolf. The wait staff was fantastic. Our waitress, Lauren, was super friendly and suggested several great cocktails. All of the employees were helpful.  ￼The ambience was amazing. I highly recommend this restaurant.   ￼
reviews.author: Adrienne

reviews.text: We had a great time and food and drinks were good. The veiws were beautiful.
reviews.author: Amber

reviews.text: This was our third time here in 2 weeks. The first two times were great. This time everything was off. The time it took to get our food was almost an hour. The wings never came.  they served the beet salad without the cheese and when we asked for it the gave us graded parmigiana, and the steak was overcooked and scarce,doesn’t even go with it. the fries were cold and burger overcooked. The drinks and craballs were delicious. We will wait to try again. But we’re very disappointed this time.
reviews.author: Dennis

reviews.text: Amy was amazing , exceptional service , very fun atmosphere, coming back forsure
reviews.author: william

reviews.text: I made a reservation and when we arrived they were unable to seat us. The hostess sent us upstairs to a rooftop bar that was not even part of Wolf. We were told we get a call when our seats were available. I never received a call. We checked back in 30 mins later and still no availability. They offered for us to sit in the “Library”, which was fine, but it felt like a secluded area and the service felt like everything took forever. Which is understandable at a busy establishment like this but we were only drinking. We were lucky we got two drinks in a two hour span. The frustrating part was the table next to us seemed to be getting served much quicker even though they had 3x the people in their party. We ended up just going up to the bar to get our check so we could leave. It was overall pretty disappointing. I have been to other Vanderpump restaurants and never experienced this before, so it must have been a flook.
reviews.author: Amanda

reviews.text: We came here to celebrate my sisters birthday. This has got to be one of the most beautiful restaurants I have ever come to. The decor is absolutely stunning as expected. Of course, the goat cheese balls that people rave about were mouthwatering, the Seabass was spectacular and so full of flavor and the Vanderpump Pino Noir was great !  Would definitely recommend coming here
reviews.author: Laurie

reviews.text: Great atmosphere for a dinner or a round of drinks.
reviews.author: Brian

reviews.text: Ambiance was great. Service was great. Did not feel rushed.  Food was mediocre. ￼
reviews.author: Kristen

reviews.text: My husband and I went out for a date night here. The drinks were really good. I usually don't order the same drink over and over but the Pumptini was so good and light that I kept ordering it. For food we ordered the goat cheese balls, bread, lobster ceviche crisps and shrimp tacos. Everything was really good. We definitely will be back.
reviews.author: Ciara

reviews.text: Kelsey the server was the best we had an amazing time!!
reviews.author: Emmalyn

reviews.text: Way too loud. Drowns out how nice of a build out they did. Feels like you're in a club, not a nice restaurant
reviews.author: Donny

reviews.text: Reservations were about 30 minutes late, but I attribute that to the newness of the restaurant. Service was outstanding. Food was very good and large portions. I had the pork chop and my wife had the salmon. Both cooked perfectly. Cocktails were good but a bit over priced. Nice ambiance but it get a bit clubby and loud once the DJ started (8pm). Reminds me a bit of SHIV in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Kevin

reviews.text: Such a cool atmosphere! Food presentation beautiful but the food itself needs some work, new place so I’m sure they will get it worked out. Great service!
reviews.author: Sarah

reviews.text:
Great place. Unfortunately, some of the seats do not have backing and you end up sitting on a cushion.
Very uncomfortable. It’s not as nice as some of the Las Vegas places, but it has great atmosphere. ￼
reviews.author: Richard

reviews.text: Food and drinks were amazing. The goat cheese balls are worth the hype, we also loved the shrimp tacos, brisket tri tip bolognese and the espresso martini!
reviews.author: Cassandra

reviews.text: Food was good, but very limited options. Definitely more of a lounge. Drinks were great, service amazing, ambience perfection. If you’re looking for a nice date night, special occasion to celebrate, highly recommend. ￼
reviews.author: Tia

reviews.text:
Nice view. Server was attentive when she was available, but she seemed overloaded. Bussers took our flatware with appetizer plates, and we had to chase someone down to get replacements. Steak and pork were both overcooked, dry, and relatively cold. They're going to need to step up their food game if they want to compete in this area.  Beautifully decorated, but extremely loud. Felt more like being in a club than a nice restaurant. The seats without backs were a little odd. I know the person sitting next to me was grumbling about having a sore back. 

Overall it feels like they're still learning. We'll try again in 3-4 months to see if they managed to pull things together.
reviews.author: Roger

reviews.text: Been twice and had a great experience both times! It’s a busy place but so fun to people watch. Cocktails are amazing and the food is solid. The filet is so worth the money- beet salad was another highlight and over all the cost was reasonable. Will be back!
reviews.author: Jamie

reviews.text:
The restaurant was spectacular, the ambiance was incredible and the food was great. We tried the famous goat cheese balls, they were good, I expected a wow factor to the flavor but this could just be personal preference. The Camel Mac was AMAZING, the flavor was wow. 
Our server Amy was amazing, she was beyond professional but also personable. The hostess' could do a bit better. We were at the front of the line with 3 other couples behind us and we stood there awkwardly for about 2min before one of them decided to look up from their conversation and say hello. Not the end of the world but as the hostest stand is first impression, they could improve but the rest of the staff and restaurant absolutely made up for that. I highly recommend! I wish there was a location in our hometown back in Alberta!!
reviews.author: Mackenzie

reviews.text:
Wolf by Lisa Vanderpump is beyond stunning chic, glamorous, and absolutely beautiful in every detail. From the moment you walk in, the vibe is cool and elevated, and the ambiance makes it feel like such a special night out. Plus… the people watching was top notch.
We started with the bread and it was SO good soft, warm, and delicious (honestly addictive). The real standout though was the tuna tostada… quite possibly the best I’ve ever had. It was so clean and light, perfectly cold and fresh, and just melted in your mouth.
For our entrée we ordered the filet, and it was tender, flavorful, and cooked perfectly.
Drinks were just as amazing, we tried the Pumptini and the mule and both were refreshing and delicious.
Overall, Wolf is the perfect mix of luxury, style, and seriously great food. Can’t wait to go back!
reviews.author: Heather

reviews.text: I love all of the Vanderpump restaurants! This one has probably one of the most beautiful interiors of all! <3 I went when they newly opened, and the food was good, but I like the food in her Vegas restaurants better… It may have been just grand opening/ opening “getting used to”. menu etc. I will definitely be back! The cocktails, as always, knocked it out out of the park!! Oh, the the Views!!!!! Just WOW!!!
reviews.author: Tammy

reviews.text: We had an excellent experience celebrating my husbands birthday here. Great food and excellent service. I highly recommend the Ken’s Haddock n chips, best I’ve ever had
reviews.author: Tracy

reviews.text: Excellent service. Atmosphere 10/10. Cocktails fabulous. Bread and goat cheese balls 10/10. Shrimp tacos 10/10. Brisket Tri Tip bolognese was overcooked and the meat was dry. Brownie desert was the worst I’ve ever had. It was burnt. They’ve only been open a short time. I’m sure these till get rectified and we can’t wait to return.
reviews.author: DOUGLAS

reviews.text:
The wait staff was great & very professional .
Food was served @ very reasonable time.
reviews.author: Judy

reviews.text: The restaurant is within a beautiful hotel in Scottsdale located on the 7th floor. The restaurant is beautiful inside and has great views of Camelback Mountain. Service was great. We had the bread for an appetizer, and it was very good. The fish and chips were really great. The portion was huge and cooked perfectly. I would recommend this restaurant for anyone wanting a nice lunch or dinner.
reviews.author: Ross

reviews.text:
We had a reservation for 2 of us and the 2 different tables that were offered to us were awkwardly round and so large we would not have been able to hear each other. The chairs are so cumbersome and large that we would not have been able to move them to be a closer distance at the table to hear each other in this very loud venue. We opted to sit closer together at the bar and we had outstanding service from Mike.
The views are nice, perfect for sunset.
Our entrees were so disappointing. There are not any unique options on the menu so we ordered a filet and the sea bass. Both were served with a very greasy thinly sliced potato ring and the filet a vegetable medley that was very undercooked, almost raw. The sea bass was very dry, flavorless and did not seem very fresh. The filet was also lacking in flavor. The beet salad was one of the best I’ve ever had, great flavor and perfectly lightly dressed. Mike let us know the kitchen would not split the salad for us but he was great in splitting it for us.
reviews.author: christine

reviews.text: The service was amazing, every employee we made contact were nothing but professional and courteous.
reviews.author: T.J.

reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant, but unfortunately, the food came out cold and some dishes were too salty. The service wasn’t up to standards.
reviews.author: Ritza

reviews.text: We sat literally right behind the host stand it became cold since they had the patio doors open by the pool. It took us a hot minute to get us our beverages and then coursing out our meals was off significantly. We were done before way before the next entrée showed up. Beverages were empty didn’t get asked for more drinks til we asked. I don’t know how many tables she had going but Monday night late night and for the money spent just expecting better for the price point, restaurant and location..
reviews.author: Rina

reviews.text: Beautiful atmosphere, staff was very friendly.  Staff was B grade for service.  I had to ask for new flatware when the meal came after appetizers as they removed the original flatware.  One of the signature cocktails was not available.  The price suggests a higher level of service but the overall experience was still nice.
reviews.author: anne

reviews.text: Great vibes, food, and service. Lobster tacos!!!!!
reviews.author: Carolyn

reviews.text: Had a reservation for 7:00pm and did not get seated until 7:25pm. They seated multiple groups in front of us who came in much later. Once inside the server was great and food was good. The seats at our table did not have a backrest was essentially an ottoman so my back was rather sore after dinner.
reviews.author: TJ

reviews.text: Service was excellent and it is absolutely gorgeous. Food is extremely average if even. I would maybe say it is below all the surrounding restaurants in town but it has a cute vibe.
reviews.author: Rachael

reviews.text: Would definitely recommend, will be going back!!  Great establishment!!
reviews.author: Angie

reviews.text: Wonderful staff! Blake  (Hollywood!)& Nicole are exceptional!!!
reviews.author: Richard

reviews.text: Best place to eat! Amazing food ! Great service! !
reviews.author: Michele

reviews.text: First time here, cool place however, they sat us 15 minutes after our reservation. Also, I got a phone call once we receded from the restaurant saying our table was ready, and I advised that we had already been seated. After that, someone came to our table asking if we were celebrating something and if I could confirm my name on the reservation for the table, we were already sitting at. It was a little offputting. There was no silverware at the table until after we received our appetizer. They forgot part of our order however they gave us a dessert on the restaurant due to this. Overall, the food was pretty good however the drinks were a little overpriced. The experience was good however I’m not sure. I will be back anytime soon.
reviews.author: Jennie

reviews.text:
The ambiance was cool and beautiful! All of the drinks were great as well as the food. However the service wasn’t great. I had a reservation for 7:15 and unfortunately didn’t get seated until 8pm. There wasn’t much communication other than were running behind and they said maybe 20 minutes but it was more than double that. I went for my birthday and have been to Sur for my birthday in the past where they do the sparkler candle for the experience. However at Wolf it was unfortunately very mediocre and didn’t even have a candle to make it special. 

I’d go back again but probably just for drinks next time.
reviews.author: Natalie

reviews.text: An overall horrible experience. Our reservation was set for 445 and we weren’t sat for an hour and a half later.  The excuse was “ We don’t have many tables for 8”. Lack-lister response and I don’t buy it.  Given this, we’re forced to sit outside by the pool where it was chilly, and we were pressured over and over to have our dinner outside instead of inside. We asked 3 times when we would be seated and got zero answers. Even one of the managers said they weren’t involved in our issue. Really?! Although they did decide to comp the appetizers and one round of drinks that we had, we missed out on seeing the fabulous sunset over Camelback Mountain and an enjoyable atmosphere . When we finally did get sat in the dining room, the service was slow, and a few  of our meals were served cold. And, we were the one’s getting rushed out so they could sit the next customers and we weren’t even dining for an hour. For all of the hype that  came with this restaurant coming into town we didn’t experience anything but below average all the way around.    Such a disappointing experience. The worst thing is that the managers didn’t even care. If I would give zero stars, I would. No recommendations to vosit will be coming from me or my family.
reviews.author: Gina

reviews.text: This was an awesome experience, the food was delish, the ambience, decor and scenic view was incredible! Our server was really friendly and really attentive, I just didn't like that we stood at the hostess table for over 5 minutes before anyone acknowledged our presence. Literally people were coming dropping off menus and walking away without saying a word! Then finally I guess this was the hostess came and checked us in. Don't get me wrong everyone was super nice, it just felt kinda odd that we stood there so long waiting to get checked in. But the food, price, location and overall experience made up for that so I won't complain. I will be going back, for sure!
reviews.author: Michelle

reviews.text:
A lot of potential once the food gets better.

The wolf has been on my list and being an avid Real Housewives fan I definitely had to come and dine here , and just like new restaurants in the discovery phase , the food is not always good , having seen a couple of reviews like this , I felt like I wanted to make a decision on my own .

I ordered the BRISKET & TRI TIP BOLOGNESE which I my opinion lacked enough sauce , the seasoning was just perfect , overall the dish could be better ,5.5/10. My friend had TRICOLORE RISOTTO , it is beautiful plated , I tasted it and it was better than what I would give it a 6/10. My other friend had COLOSSAL SHRIMP TACOS , she rated them a 6/10 . We also had CAVIAR & CHIPS , it pretty much just like any caviar and chips combo we loved it though . Our favorite item we had on the menu was the YUCCA FRIES we all loved them so much , the nice and crispy on the outside , soft on the inside and well seasoned, plus the dipping sauce made the perfect pairing .

The drinks honestly where the highlight of our experience as they are perfectly curated, I had the HUFF & PUFF 10/10 such a perfect old fashioned , the SHEEP'S CLOTHING is also another amazing cocktail, has the perfect sweetness and kick to it definitely can’t go wrong .

All this along with such a vibrant ambiance in a perfect location . Lastly the staff and the service are in our experience professional and attentive and knowledgeable about what is being served . So Overall we will go back and maybe next time food will  have the experience from a 7/10 to 10/10
reviews.author: hasifa

reviews.text: Made a reservation for me and my daughter at 8:45, had to wait another 15 minutes just to be seated which defeats the purpose of a reservation. We were offered to sit at the bar? Not sure why but we decided to wait for a table. The service was extremely slow and the food was ok , nothing out of the ordinary. Ordered the salmon and the vegetables  under it were extremely raw. There is also a venue admin fee that is no where to be seen in the menu, if you’re going to charge extra fees please allow the customer to make a choice. Don’t think i’ll be back and will definitely not recommend. Too many options around the area that are way better.
reviews.author: sara

reviews.text: Of course you have to taste the famous goat cheese balls and they are worth it! My friend and I shared the tuna tartare tostadas that were so good and fresh! I prob could have had that as my meal and been very satisfied! We also shared the brisket tri tip bolognese. The dish was a little cold however, I’m not quite sure if it came out that way or it got cold because we were eating the tostadas. They could have maybe spaced those out a little more. The interiors are beautiful, the staff was friendly and I would say my only complaint was the noise level. The music was so loud that I feel people had to talk even louder to hear each other making it difficult to have a conversation. Really glad I got the opportunity to check it out while visiting Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Jennifer

reviews.text: I made the reservation 30 days in advance for a birthday celebration. Very disappointed that the birthday was not acknowledged. We were seated at a small table, basically at the end of the bar at the entrance where you have people standing around.  ￼￼￼ I don’t believe anybody paid any attention to details. Three of us were given  a plate the fourth not . What was going on there ? Then we were served dessert but no utensils to eat the dessert with.  The only redeeming factor was that the food was good. It really was not the evening that we all had anticipated  having. So sad.￼
reviews.author: Christel

reviews.text: I have gone to all of Vanderpump’s restaurants in Vegas. This one is good but I’ve never felt so out of place. Full of influencers and high end people. Although I was dressed expensively, I wasn’t dressed up enough. Highly recommend dressing up despite the dress code saying it’s casual. I highly recommend the Pump and Bump martini. The goat cheese balls are still awesome. The smoked chicken wings are ok, I’d say pass on those. Everything else was good. Service was fantastic. They have an amazing staff and they work very hard! I’ll be back but dressed up more!
reviews.author: Amanda

reviews.text:
I thought the decor was great based on the name and vibe of restaurant. Was very disappointed in the service. From the front receptionist not helpful at all to say they don’t do wait lists or give recommendations how to best book. We ended up going to open table and putting an alert and got in.

The servers would constantly circle around and grab drinks before finished or plates with food still not eaten. It felt so rushed and didn’t get to sit back and enjoy the food and cocktails and each other companies. It felt very much get in and out. If they want time constraints they should tell you upfront. I even asked our waitress if they needed our table for another party since we felt so rushed. Super disappointing service.
reviews.author: Jodi

reviews.text: What a fantastic place! The drinks were fabulous. The views of camelback were amazing!
reviews.author: Audrey

reviews.text:
We recently dined here for what was meant to be a relaxed lunch with beautiful views and great ambiance — and to be fair, the setting truly delivers. The food was also very good once it finally arrived.

Unfortunately, the service significantly overshadowed the experience.

Our reservation was for 1:45pm, yet we weren’t seated until after 2:00. What should have been a leisurely lunch stretched into a three-hour ordeal; we didn’t finish our meal until nearly 5:00pm due to extremely slow service and multiple ordering errors. Several items were brought to the table incorrectly, including a meal for one of our non-drinking guests — who, ironically, was later “compensated” with a round of shots sent by the manager.

While the gesture may have been intended as hospitality, it missed the mark given that not everyone at the table drinks. What we were truly hoping for was attentiveness, accountability, and a willingness to correct the experience.

When we voiced our concerns, the response felt dismissive rather than solution-oriented, which was disappointing given the caliber this restaurant appears to strive for.

This is a place with tremendous potential — great food, stunning views, and a lovely atmosphere — but service is what transforms a meal into a memorable experience. With more thoughtful management and improved pacing, this restaurant could easily match its beautiful setting with equally strong hospitality.
reviews.author: Amy

reviews.text: Had a reservation for lunch. Restaurant is beautiful and the staff invited us to walk through it.   Service was great although it took a while to get our food but this is the kind of place where you want to stay awhile. Beet salad was good and shrimp tacos were the bomb. Enjoyed the 7th story view of the city.
reviews.author: Julie

reviews.text: From start to finish this experience was not amazing. Even tho we had a reservation we had to wait 20 mins for our table. Once we got our table half our party literally had to dine in a backless stool. Our server greeted us by saying they had good food and cheap prices. So off-putting. The timing of the drinks and food was so off. Received food and then received drinks by the time we finished our food. This happened both during apps and the main course. The food was lack luster, flavorless and honestly super disappointing. I maybe had two bites of my dish and no one even bothered to ask how our experience was going. Our entire party was left disappointed and hungry.

reviews.text: Absolutely Fabulous!!! Packed house- gorgeous lighting and decor is so very LVP and the food was divine!!! Martini fab as well. Cozy atmosphere and wonderful bar seating!

reviews.text: The restaurant is beautiful but needs many more gluten-free options and the kitchen needs to be better about food allergies!

reviews.text: The place is beautiful, drinks and food took a long time to come out. Service was good and staff very nice.

reviews.text: Had anniversary dinner and it was amazing! Loved our server Amy she was amazing and great customer service will be back again ￼

reviews.text: Lovely meeting place for lunch & dinner with beautiful ambience.

reviews.text: This was an amazing dining “experience”! I would highly recommend to everyone! Service was top notch… special shoutout to Nikki! The atmosphere is absolutely stunning and the food was just delicious! 10/10 stars! We will be back!
