reviews.text: The design of the restaurant is fantastic.  Very elegant and nothing less than you would expect.  Beautiful.  The staff was friendly and welcoming.  We had appetizers, drinks and entrees.  The food wasn’t what I expected.  Everything was ok but not fantastic.  The goat cheese ball I had was basically empty but that can happen with fried cheese.  The chicken was a little dry.  The shrimp tacos were ok .  The best thing we had was the burger, the noble bread and the potatoes with the  chicken and the French Fries.  The pumptini did not disappoint and neither did the old fashion.  It’s an experience I would recommend based on how beautiful the restaurant itself is.
reviews.author: Jen

reviews.text: As it’s a new restaurant they’re still working out kinks when it comes to service. Overall it was a great experience. We went for my friends birthday, the staff wished her a Happy Birthday and brought out a free dessert. We ordered the Berry Sexy Mocktail, Pumptini, Tuna Tar Tar, Sea Bass and Salmon. Each item had a great presentation and tasted wonderful!
reviews.author: Emily

reviews.text:
Our group loves food experiences and we love a good value too.
Wolf was awesome but we were all a bit taken back by the 3.5% “venue admin charge” added to the bill.
This is on top of the 20% auto gratuity!
It does leave us with a bit of a Debbie downer feeling. Why not just add this to the actual cost of the menu item or the gratuity?
Or leave it to us to add a few more $$ to the servers pocket!
reviews.author: Lila

reviews.text: Was great a little exspensive but will go back. They need a happy hour!

reviews.text: Woof great atmosphere very  opulent beautiful view of mountains A Instagram-worthy aesthetics, and high-quality cocktails Food is good but not great. Our waiter was really nice and attentive.
reviews.author: Natasha

reviews.text: Service was on the slow side. Ambience was fantastic, good food.
reviews.author: Joan

reviews.text: The smash burger was excellent, beet salad and goat cheese balls were great. Not a huge fan of the lobster tacos, but that’s just a personal preference.  A little glitch with the frose maker but no biggie, the server and the manager were very nice and took care of it and sent over a few drinks. (Totally unnecessary to do so but very nice!). Going back for Valentine’s and a staycation at the hotel. The view is also very pretty!
reviews.author: Alexandria

reviews.text: I booked Wolf for my husband's birthday lunch and I don't think we will be returning. The decor is gaudy/kitschy in the light of day- all cheap fake flowers and foliage. The service leaves much to be desired. When we checked in for the reservation the hostess acknowledged the birthday celebration but our server Blake never mentioned it once. The wait for the food after ordering was much too long, especially considering the restaurant was maybe 35% full. The food itself was ok- the goat cheese balls and the fish and chips were excellent. . . the tuna tostada was under seasoned and really difficult to eat. After we finished eating and our plates were cleared, we sat for at least 15 minutes waiting for Blake. . . I thought maybe he would bring a small dessert for the birthday but after waiting for so long we signaled to him for the check and that was that. All in all, I expect much more for a $96 lunch. I predict based on this experience that the restaurant will not be in business long once the Vanderpump shine wears off.

reviews.text: Food was okay. Our server was good* I do want to make that clear however, I don’t think any of the tables ever had adequate place settings around us and neither did ours when we got sat. So not our servers fault but when our food was served we obviously were without utensils. And honestly I don’t get the hype of any of the food. I’ll be back because of the vibe and the view but it’ll be just for a drink and on to the next place. I wouldn’t recommend anything more than that here.

reviews.text: Music could be just turned down a notch while still keeping vibe.  Service at bar needs help.  Food is great and comes out quickly.

reviews.text:
Absolute beautiful restaurant… fortunately we had a wonderful server and the manager was very accommodating which helped the shortcomings.

We were seated for dinner at a space that really was more like a cocktail lounge and it was very uncomfortable … small round tables put together for a party of 6 and stools instead of chairs with backs.

Food was very good but limited menu.

Our cocktails were not good at all. For what you pay for a drink there they should be absolute perfect… The one was so bad we sent it back and ordered something different. I do not mind paying 20+ for a cocktail but it needs to be perfect!!

This review makes me a little sad because we love some of Lisa’s other restaurants and we were excited that she’s now in Scottsdale… We will definitely give it another try in a couple months.

￼

reviews.text: We were expecting a great experience for my bday dinner (party of 6). We had the worst service ever, the place was ridiculously dark, the music was outrageously loud, and the food was grossly overpriced. We were also charged a “venue fee” for dining there. Don’t waste your time or money dining here when there are so many other fabulous restaurants in the area to choose from. We were highly disappointed with our experience.
reviews.author: Margo

reviews.text:
Feedback regarding our recent dining experience at Wolf by Vanderpump, which unfortunately did not meet the level of quality or service we were anticipating.

I made reservations to celebrate my wife’s birthday, as she previously enjoyed the Las Vegas location and we were expecting a similarly upscale experience. The décor and overall ambiance of the restaurant were excellent, and the sunset views were truly beautiful.

We arrived approximately an hour early with the intention of enjoying the 8th-floor patio and sunset; however, the patio was closed due to a private event. We were advised to wait at the bar, where we received decent service, and the hostess indicated she would come find us when our table was ready. When our reservation time arrived, I checked back with the hostess stand and was told the table was ready and that I needed to bring our group back to the stand. Given that we were all seated together at the bar, it would have been far more appropriate and hospitable for the hostess to simply come notify us directly.

Considering this was a celebration dinner for five adults, I was also surprised to be seated at a very small circular table positioned next to a pillar. The limited space required constant maneuvering of plates, glassware, and wine bottles, which detracted from the overall comfort and experience.

Additionally, while I am a college football fan and thankful to see the National Championship game, I was surprised to see televisions visible in the dining area, as this felt inconsistent with the upscale dining atmosphere we were expecting from a concept like Wolf.

The food itself was good and represented solid value. However, based on the overall service experience and seating accommodations, this is not a venue I would likely return to or recommend. I share this feedback constructively and hope it can be helpful in improving the guest experience moving forward.
reviews.author: HerbertH

reviews.text: Let’s be honest.  You’re coming here for a reason.  You love Lisa Vanderpump, or you love gorgeously designed new restaurants, or you love amazing food and cocktails or you are just trying to enjoy the finer things in Scottsdale.  Whatever the reason, you’re going to walk away overjoyed.  The bottom line is simple - we go out to eat at fancy spots so that when we leave - we feel good.  And Wolf delivers on that goal.   What helped us is that we had Amazing Amy as our sever/guide/visionary throughout the night.  She was flawless.  It got to the point where we were actually sad to leave because Amy’s presence and recommendations and positive frame really made our evening spectacular.  At the end of the day, no matter how fancy the spot, you need to deliver on the service and food - and Wolf crushes that.   Go now!
reviews.author: Trey

reviews.text:
Goat cheese balls were amazing.
The burger was super salty.
Shrimp tacos were basic in my opinion.
Drinks took forever to come out and the food.

I will give it grace since it’s a new restaurant opening. I was disappointed that they were out of their famous goat cheese balls & when  I inquired about an extra tuna tartare taco be added to the plate bc it only is served with 3 (it’s hard to share with 2 people) they wouldn’t do that so I had to order an extra plate.

We had the Campari salad which lacked flavor and presentation needs improvement  and followed that the tricolor risotto - recommend you offer an option of protein with it. Our server Sophia was awesome and attentive and when we go back will ask for her.  This was a celebration for our wedding anniversary and so Sophia conp’d our desert.

reviews.text:
High marks for the ambiance and location but the food needs work. The goat cheese balls and the bread are top tier. The sea bass had zero flavor and was dry as a bone. The ribeye sauce was strange (looks like chimichurri but didn’t taste anything like it) and the fruit cobbler for desert was inedible. We may be back for the appetizers but that’s about it unfortunately.

reviews.text:
I wanted to love this place, I really really did.
I am a huge LVP fan and was excited to learn she was opening a restaurant in our neck of the woods.
My husband obliged my curiosity and agreed to trying out Wolf for our date night.
The ambiance is delectable with every detail accounted for. I remarked at how each patron would take their seat and begin to look around at the mesmerizing atmosphere.
We were seated without a drink menu, weird but ok. When asked what drinks we wanted the waitress quickly remedied the situation and presented us with a drink menu.
We ordered Wolf bread for an appetizer. Chilean Sea Bass and the filet for our main course and the brownie for dessert.
The food was good, but I expected more. The filet was not a great cut and had a lot of fat and sinew in it. The seabass was good! The bread, although delicious and piping hot was served with two balls of ice cold butter. Have you ever tried to butter a piece of warm bread with ice cold butter? It doesn’t work. The bread comes out on a cutting board stabbed with a bread knife (reminds me of the good ole days in college going to the fine dining of Outback Steakhouse and getting the free bread appetizer ;)). This bread is not free. It is $16. Are you kidding me? A loaf of bread should never be $16. The seabass and filet were priced reasonably at $59 each. The brownie was delicious and nice and moist however the ice cream on top tasted as though it went bad, like sour milk.
As for the service, I expect more. You are in the area of Maple and Ash, Ocean 44, Maestros, etc. you need to step it up. Our main entrees came out five minutes after the appetizer, so not timed well. A steak knife was not provided to my husband for his meat. He ended up using the bread knife from the wolf bread to cut the meat (again the sinew made it such that a butter knife did not work). Our water was never refilled until the very end. It’s little things like this that need to improve in order to compete with the other swanky

reviews.text: Unfortunately my dinner party of 3 had a bad experience. We had reservations for over a week at 8:15pm and got there on time and was told we would have to wait which was no concern at all but they sent me an email while we were standing there and they cancelled my reservation as we were there in the waiting area. I continued to check in with the Hostess on our seating and was informed that there were no open seats available and that “they cannot rush peoples experience for dining” (the hostesses exact words) which I also understand but then again, what’s the purpose of a reservation if your Team hasn’t properly sat tables and made the appropriate room? We ended up getting seated a little after 10pm and then it took 30 minutes just to get a server. They left one of those gross wet bar mats on one of the chairs (odd spot for it to be located) but we requested to have that cleaned up. The table ordered the Caesar Salad to begin with as an appetizer and we had to send the dish back to the kitchen because there was something really off with the flavor and it had a grainy texture to it that felt like we were eating sand. It was gritty in the teeth. The waitress said others had also complained about the same salad so not sure what was going on there. The rest of the food we ordered came out with no issues so that was a win for the evening. The decor is gorgeous but the service was not good. Our poor waitress tried her best but we had to track down another server to get our check. I don’t know if we just happened to encounter an odd evening but it was an overall disappointing experience after all the hype I’ve heard around the new restaurant.

reviews.text: We had a reservation for my husband’s birthday and wanted to catch sunset. We arrived a little early and had a lovely cocktail at the bar (Goldwater a premium margarita). We did receive a phone call at 5:57 asking where we were for our 6pm reservation which i thought was a little odd considering I had checked in with the hostess when we arrived and said we were getting a drink at the bar since we were early.  We were seated at our table and greeted by the manager who was very friendly our waitress was so sweet. Unfortunately they were out of 2 of 3 steaks offered on their menu and several appetizers. The menu isn’t very extensive to begin with so I found it very odd they were out of a few of the main entrees going into a busy Saturday night. We ended up leaving because my husband didn’t want to have a salad for dinner.  I’d be willing to give it another try because I know it’s a newer place and maybe they just need to get a better handle on their inventory but this isn’t their first restaurant and I find it elementary that a place like thus would run out of steaks early in the evening. On a positive note some of the best views in Scottsdale and the cocktails were amazing as you’d expect.

reviews.text:
Wolf by Vanderpump was an incredible experience from start to finish.

We visited on Jan 9 for a special late Christmas dinner — a fine-dining tradition I’ve shared with my son since he was eight (he’s now 30). Our server, Sarah, was outstanding and made the evening feel truly special. She was also training a new server who was equally kind and attentive.

reviews.text:
So disappointed with the entire experience. First, we waited for reservations, they said we could not wait at the bar or outdoor patio and then they gave us the worst table in the restaurant. The giggly tonic for $27 was terrible.  For appetizers we had the goat cheese balls. They give you five balls for $17. Two were overcooked three were undercooked. We had the hush puppies. They give you sour cream to dip them in ?? The Seabass was delicious, but the serving size was smaller than a deck of cards and had six little tomatoes with it. The Caesar salad was full of red cabbage and carrots. My daughter only ate two bites of it.  The potatoes that come with the pork Tomahawk steak were burned black, we even showed the waitress and she laughed. There is no way a chef or server should have sent them out. Drinks were very overpriced with small pours. It was very loud in the restaurant, the music they were playing was more techno and something much younger people would listen to. Your sitting so far away from the people you came with in these big King chairs that you cannot hear each other. They were very uncomfortable.When we ask for sweet and low for our tea, they came back with two packages of Stevia and said no one can find any sugar caddies.
They ran out of spoons so they gave us a huge serving spoons to eat our tiny dessert. They do not have any non-alcoholic beer or wine.I was so disappointed. The restaurant itself is beautiful, but there needs to be good food for someone to want to come back. We have been to the restaurant at Caesars Palace in Las Vegas and it was delicious. It was my Christmas present to my daughter and her wife and I was so sad.

The service was terrible, we ordered the goat cheese appetizer which took over an hour to come to the table. Once it did it was not worth the wait. About 30 minutes later we received our entrees and they were even worse. I had the chicken and it tasted like they dumped half a salt shaker on it. My wife had the risotto and it tasted like they served her a microwave dinner you would find in a grocery store freezer section. Very disappointed and would certainly not recommend.

reviews.text:
From the moment we stepped into Wolf by Vanderpump, we were captivated by its elegant, chic atmosphere and sophisticated vibe. The menu impressed us immediately, featuring standout dishes like their renowned cheese balls, irresistible truffle fries, perfectly cooked prime filet, and a truly decadent churro dessert—all beautifully complemented by refreshing, creative cocktails, including the wildly popular Pumptini.
The evening's true highlight, however, was our exceptional server, Hannah. Her attentiveness, genuine warmth, playful sense of humor, and spot-on recommendations transformed an already wonderful meal into an unforgettable experience. Hannah went above and beyond to ensure every detail was flawless, making us feel truly valued and cared for. We'll definitely be returning—and we can't wait to see Hannah again. She's an absolute gem— @Wolf, don't lose her! :)

reviews.text:
We had a Fabulous experience! From the hostess to the bartender and bar backs! Everyone was friendly and service was exceptional! Food was amazing as well, we ordered the infamous goat cheese balls and tried the lobster ceviche, BOTH AMAZING! We each had the sea bass for our entree and it was to die for, melted in our mouths!
Thank you Lisa Vanderpump the ambiance and architecture/Decor was like no other! FABULOUS!! We will definitely be back.
HAPPY NEW YEAR!
reviews.author: Gina

reviews.text:
Very impressed by the food! I was a bit skeptical but almost everything was amazing. We got the goat cheese balls, crab & corn hush puppies, the bread and the Oceana carpaccio. The only thing we didn’t like was the carpaccio. Fish and fish overall very bland, needed a sauce to some sort other than oil. That being said dear god the other 3 dishes were so so good, you can’t not get the bread either! Best thing on the menu, and the two kinds of butters were so good. I really loved the hush puppies too.

Got the Caesar salad and filet for dinner and both excellent. The filet was perfectly cooked and a good quality meat. Highly recommend.

We also got the espresso martinis and omg don’t sleep on them! They come with either a cinnamon and sugar donut hole or a baby churro made fresh everyday. Also, came with a piece of chocolate that said Wolf on it. Very well done!

The restaurant is also stunning, thechandeliers and lighting is amazing. Will be back!

reviews.text: The food was good but the service was not at all.  I ordered a soda water with lime 2 times and just got a water with a lime since I’m not drinking. My friend ordered a second drink a greyhound and was brought some big gin drink that no one liked and never brought her greyhound or asked if she even liked the drink. No one came by to refill waters and we were never asked if we wanted anything else or dessert. I hope that the service improves since it is still new. We could have been in and out and turned the table for other guests waiting if the service wasn’t so slow.

reviews.text: I was very excited to try Wolf. I’m a big fan of Vanderpump Rules and have been to some of Lisa’s LA bars/restaurants. My sister and I went for lunch on Friday, 1/2 it was not very busy and there were a lot of workers present, but customer service was non existent. There was a hair on the appetizer plate when we initially arrived. Our first round of drinks took 25-30 mins to arrive. I ordered an old fashioned which came with a “presentation”. I wasn’t aware. I went to the restroom when our drinks finally came and my sister said I’d be right back but the server went on with the presentation and told my sister she could just record it on her phone. If I’m ordering a $20+ drink and it’s not busy she could have waited a couple of minutes so I could have seen the “show.” Our waitress gave us little attention. I expected more from a place that just opened. Ambiance and decor were nice. My burger was good but the service was awful.
reviews.author: Karisa

reviews.text: Spent over $200 for our 4 year anniversary. Didn’t finish any of our 4 cocktails. And only finished 1 of the 5 meals and sides we got. Only reason I finished mine was because I spent $40 on a single meal and wasn’t going to let it go to waste. Did not get a dessert or drink or anything for our anniversary. Nothing special done or shown for us with them even knowing it was an anniversary dinner and was put on our reservation. Looking at the comments I see I won’t be getting any type of refund or service other than a sorry for the inconvenience. Definitely a disappointment to my fiancé who loves Lisa Vanderpump but this was just very disappointing all around for a special occasion all around.

reviews.text: Amazing ambience and drinks. Can’t wait to go back and try more of the food especially the desserts

I ordered the butter-seared Chilean sea bass, but it fell short as the bottom was burnt, overly salty, and tough to chew. My husband’s filet, however, was excellent and cooked beautifully. We also ordered the wolf potatoes, which were unfortunately either burnt or bland and not very enjoyable.

reviews.author: Kalie

My complaints are we tried to order cocktails that were not approved but still on the menu as well as kitchen made their last call and we were not warned so we didn’t get to try dessert. I’m sure with time this will improve but the service was beyond poor. We sat 10minutes waiting for our table ( we had reservations), 10 mins without water, our cocktails also took some time. Generally the effort to be friendly was there but they need quality improvements. The menu was fun and the items themselves pulled the weight for the missing aspects from the FOH.

Spent NYE at Wolf and was very impressed. They totally revamped this space and is gorgeous inside.  Larger bar area and seating is laid out well.
Food and service was excellent and well trained staff.
So glad to see GM Paul again - truly a great GM and always makes a point to visit everyone and making sure your experience is always good.
Look forward to returning again tonight.

reviews.text: My first time trying Wolf and it was NYE. Did not disappoint! The food, drinks and service were top notch. I’ll be back!
reviews.author: Courtney

reviews.text: It was my birthday and got the worse table  you could get  and seat with no back , our server was no where to be found half of the time . Are drinks took 20 minutes to get Every-time we ordered  took over an hour to order are food .
reviews.author: Jennifer

reviews.text: Love this place. We sat at the bar and had great service and the food was amazing, we had the salmon and the Chilean sea bass which were both amazing.  We also ordered a few drinks including the salt river sour, the cry wolf which was amazing, and the desert nectar frozen drink which was perfect and not too sweet.  Not to mention a nice wine selection with a few glasses of those too.  Everything was wonderful.  The staff at the bar are very friendly too, Matt and one other guy but sorry I am blanking his name. Just a fun overall experience for us.
reviews.author: Cherie

reviews.text: The restaurant is beautiful, has a sexy moody vibe. The restaurant has only been open a couple weeks so the kitchen is still working out the kinks. Food was delicious. Fun cocktails.
reviews.author: Trish

reviews.text: Great food, server was helpful, and the ambiance was perfect. So happy they put a restaurant in that spot that represents Scottsdale!
reviews.author: Rachel

reviews.text:
We visited WOLF on New Year’s Eve to celebrate my mom’s birthday, and the experience was wonderful. While it wasn’t my first time there, it was my first time experiencing the service from start to finish, and it exceeded my expectations.

The atmosphere was fantastic, lively but not overly loud, making it perfect for table conversation.

The food and drinks were superb. I ordered the fish and chips, and it was absolutely delicious. The presentation was just as impressive as the flavor.

The waitstaff was equally outstanding. Our water glasses were never empty, and our waitress was incredibly attentive and accommodating, especially when it came to celebrating a birthday.

I would absolutely recommend giving this place a chance.
reviews.author: Tana

reviews.text:
Had reservations hostess sat us at the bar we wanted seats near the bar they said reservations we sat two hours those tables sat empty the entire time - not impressed with hostess
Very uncomfortable bar seats nowhere to put your legs too much decor under bar
reviews.author: Missi

reviews.text: I went there alone for dinner and sat at the bar. ￼ The bartender, walked by several times, never acknowledged me however when a couple sat down next to me, he immediately served them Water and offered them menus, and after he was done giving them all the menus and the water. He then finally asked me who had been there a good 10 minutes earlier if I wanted to drink menu.  He then proceeded to be super attentive to everybody else while I had to ask for a food menu and seek to make eye contact with him for him to serve me. The food was good. The drinks were strong. The service sucked.  I tipped the usual 20%  but he could’ve gotten away more than that. All he had to do what’s his job! Ridiculous ￼
reviews.author: Claudia

reviews.text:
Wolf by Vanderpump absolutely lives up to the hype.

From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere felt elevated but still welcoming…moody lighting, gorgeous details, and such a fun energy. The service was attentive without being overbearing, which honestly makes or breaks a dining experience for me.

Every dish we tried was thoughtfully done—bold flavors, beautiful presentation, and nothing felt rushed or careless. It’s the kind of place where you can tell intention went into every detail, from the menu to the overall vibe.

Perfect for a date night, girls’ night, or celebrating something special. We left already talking about what we want to order next time—which is always the sign of a great restaurant.

Would absolutely come back. 🖤
reviews.author: Sydney

reviews.text: It was actually pretty good. I believe the customer service was elevated because we went NYE at 4:30pm. The only downside was that it was very cold because they had the sliding glass doors open by the pool area and it was freezing. That kind’ve messed up some of my ability to enjoy it because I wanted to leave. Overall, food was yummy, decor was impeccable and the service was good. I’d come back.
reviews.author: Tanei

reviews.text: We ordered drinks and not only did they take 20 minutes to come when they did the martinis were 1/2 full and the beer was warm. Our appetizer came out before the drinks. Our waitress was sweet about it all and said the bar was backed up but we were there for lunch mid day and the restaurant was maybe at 30 percent capacity. Very disappointing service especially for a Vanderpump restaurant. It won’t last long in Scottsdale if that level of service continues.
reviews.author: Barbara

reviews.text: Gigi was amazing .Friendly courteous and served us very well.Great atmosphere for a lunch date .Loved it , will be back .
reviews.author: harv

reviews.text: The service was outstanding!   Our server Phoebe was a pure pleasure!  We had the Wolf bread which was delicious.  Goat Cheese balls not my fav.  We also had the burger which was fantastic!!!
reviews.author: Rhonda

reviews.text:
Love the decor & overall vibe. We were seated in the back library room & loved it. Felt like we were in Lisa’s home!
Food was ok. Fried goat balls & prime filet were excellent. The salmon was overcooked & not wild. Drink menu needs more fun choices.
We will return & tell friends about it - just don’t eat the fish!
reviews.author: Kathleen

reviews.text: The restaurant is just beautiful. Well done on the design. So fancy but cozy. We loved the atmosphere, still needs work on the wait staff and food. The bread was cold, the goat cheese balls were cold…BUT WE understand it’s just getting on your game, we will be back.
reviews.author: VICKIE

reviews.text: Amazing welcoming experience! Will be back soon loved the vibe
reviews.author: Juliah

reviews.text: Great place great service my steak and wrap was filled with way too much potatoes one piece of meat
reviews.author: Kendra

reviews.text:
Overall we had an enjoyable lunch. The  ambiance was “very Lisa” with the elaborate crystal chandeliers. It was very noisy though and we had some difficulty talking across the table. Nicole, our Server, was very efficient as well as warm and friendly. Our Grand Daughters (14 & 11) enjoyed sharing their love for Taylor Swift with her. We just watched the first couple of episodes of the new VanderPump Rules and we enjoyed sharing our views on some of the new staff.
Bar service was very slow though, and pricey. A well Bourbon Manhattan was very small for $20! It was served in a very shallow champagne glass rather than a traditional martini glass. Food however, was very good. Our family enjoyed the Hanger Steak Salad and Little Gem Caesar Salad. The Farmers MarkWrap was good but could have used a little crunch. Our son enjoyed the Wolf Burger, although it was very small for $24. The Goat Cheese Ball appetizer was only marginal and pricey. Two out of the six balls contained very little cheese. We were celebrating our Grand Daughter’s 14th Birthday and the Churros dessert was a welcome surprise. We may return for dinner at some point for another special occasion.
reviews.author: Linda

reviews.text: Beautiful views, great menu and wonderful service.
reviews.author: sally

reviews.text: Loved everything about this restaurant! I appreciate the details in everything from decor to the flavors in each dish. Will definitely be back!
reviews.author: Christina

reviews.text: Beautiful space and wonderful cocktails.  The foos was also prepared perfectly
reviews.author: Kelly

reviews.text: We loved the atmosphere! Vanderpumps never disappoint in that area. The food was amazing and the waitress was great! Very attentive and communicative. The only reason I gave it 3 stars was due to the bar. We ordered a cocktail upon being seated and it took forever to get. I ordered a second cocktail and it was never delivered. When the waitress came to take our food order, she said the bar was very behind and the drink should be there soon. So, we ordered our food along with a glass of wine to be delivered with our meal.Not saying the drinks weren’t amazing, but I ended up eating my meal without a drink. After I finished eating, my second cocktail showed up with my glass of wine. Would have been nice to have a glass of wine with my dinner. Maybe 3 stars is a little harsh upon retrospect, but that’s what I was thinking at the time. I will go back, given they just opened and are working out the bugs.
reviews.author: Frank

reviews.text: I really enjoyed the short rib pasta. We attended shortly after they opened and they were still working out the kinks, but it was a great meal with great service and if you're a RHOB fan you have to check it out!
reviews.author: Taylor

reviews.text: So happy LVP finally brought one of her restaurants to AZ! Everything was perfectly crafted out to create the most luxurious and sophisticated vibe. You can tell so much thought and care went into making your time there a true experience. Every little detail was so special-to the spinning chandeliers and wolf-fur chairs, to the amazingly designed drinks and dishes. What made the evening was seeing the sun setting over the mountains from the floor to ceiling windows. So many picture worthy moments! Most definitely recommend!
reviews.author: Elicia

reviews.text: My friend was in town and wanted to dine at Wolf. I know of the company through my interior design work. They have unique and stunning furniture which was showcased in their restaurant. It is over the top, elegant and lush. Love the chain link detail and the lighting as usual is wowza fabulous. The food was delicious...I had the heirloom beet salad which with the touch of burrata,pesto and pistachio was so fresh and flavorful. And gorgeous to look at. My friend got the smoked cowboy wings which comes in a smoker cloche to your table. She loved them and the smell was yum. We sadly wanted to get the signature wolf bread gruyere appetizer but they were out....how do you run out of your signature appetizer? Boo-hoo1 Regardless, it was an amazing atmosphere with views of camelback mountain and old town scottsdale and the food was delicious. I will go back just for that beet salad. And hopefully they will have their signature bread this time! The wait staff was exceptional, very attentive, kind and knowledgeable.
reviews.author: Donna

reviews.text: Wolf is a total step up from the previous restaurant, Seven.  Although I loved the food at Seven.  The ambiance and food at Wolf was very good!  The drinks were very tasty. When our party of 5 arrived, we were sat by the pool.  The doors were wide open and it was cold.  The hostess told us that they could close them if we were chilly.  We had to ask twice to get that to happen.  Also two of our party had never been to Ceasars Rebupblic and didn't know where the restaurant was located.  They asked the front desk attendant and they were told that Wolf was not open for lunch.  It would be helpful if the staff downstairs new about the hours of the restaurant.  All in all it was very good and the restaurant is very beautiful.
reviews.author: Suzanne

reviews.text: Amazing experience! The food and drinks were delicious but what really wowed us was the service! Our server, Anna, was so helpful with the menu and recommended some amazing dishes for us. She seemed so excited to be working at Wolf and it definitely made us feel welcomed. After our firsts bites we already started talking about the next time we visit Wolf!
reviews.author: Allison

reviews.text: WOW! What a stunning restaurant. The ambience is one of a kind. I ordered the Big Bad Wolf cocktail which had a wolf printed on the foam top. It was delicious! Our food was incredible - goat cheese balls (must try!), brisket bolognese, shrimp tacos, pork tomahawk & sea bass. All of us enjoyed our meal! We finished with the churros. Our server was outstanding - sweet, welcoming, made great suggestions. Highly recommend dining at Wolf by Vanderpump!!
reviews.author: Allie

reviews.text:
There were quite a few issues tonight:

*Out of several menu items
* Drinks were small and expensive
* Bar and food times were excessive
* My meal was not cooked  as requested- my husband finished his meal before mine came back
reviews.author: Leanne

reviews.text: Had wrong menu, they were out of three of their most popular dishes. Service was difficult to get. Food was overcooked. Lots of growing pains felt.
reviews.author: tatum

reviews.text: The food was so amazing and our server was so kind gave us free shots for my mom’s birthday and a free dessert. This is the first time I’ve been to one of Lisa Vanderpump‘s restaurants and it was a great first experience. ￼
reviews.author: Jennon

reviews.text: It was a fabulous experience for a girl's lunch.  We had a great time and food, service and everything was perfect!
reviews.author: Sherrie

reviews.text:
Last night was my first time dining here. A friend of mine, who has been coming since the restaurant opened and absolutely loves it, highly recommended that I give it a try. I made a reservation through OpenTable for 10:45 PM. There was a little confusion at the hostess stand upon arrival, but the staff was extremely friendly and able to get me seated.

I was seated at the bar at 10:54 PM. Unfortunately, after being seated, no one acknowledged me—not even to offer water. I waited until 11:09 PM without a greeting or service. There were three staff members behind the bar: two polishing glasses (one directly in front of me) and a bartender moving back and forth handling tasks, while guests around me were being served drinks. I was never asked if I wanted anything, not even water, nor was I greeted.

As this was my first visit, it wasn’t the best first impression. I eventually went back to the hostess stand to let them know I was going to leave, as I didn’t feel particularly welcomed. The hostess who initially seated me was genuinely apologetic and kind. As I was heading to the elevator, the general manager, Paul, stopped me to personally apologize and offered to buy me a drink, explaining that there were several hiccups that evening.

By that point, I had already decided to leave, so I didn’t get the opportunity to eat or drink. I do appreciate the sincere apology from both the hostess and the general manager.

The space itself is beautiful, the menu looks divine, and the drink options are very appealing. I’m willing to give this restaurant another try once it’s been around a bit longer and staff training and service flow are more refined—especially since the basic two-minute greeting rule was missed. It also wasn’t particularly busy at the time, which made the situation more confusing.

I look forward to returning in the future and hopefully having a much better experience.
reviews.author: Alicia

reviews.text: Wolf was truly an experience to remember, and every little detail was thought of impeccably. The entrance was elegant and exclusive, true to the Vanderpump brand, and once you walk past the host desk, your immediate view is the city lights of Scottsdale and Camelback Mountain. Not only that, but you few truly engulfed in the experience and decor around you. The staff was incredibly hospitable and worked to accomplish the mission of making sure the experience was flawless. My food was delicious, and I will definitely recommend this place to anyone that asks as one of the best restaurants in Phoenix-metro that is a must-try!
reviews.author: Dan

reviews.text:
Overall 5star! The only reason I have a 4 on the food was the Mac and cheese. The menu description made it sound amazing. It was good, but we were underwhelmed. It was a bit cold and  soupy. It was good, but the overall taste was the onion.  I say make it a bit more thick and creamy.

Our server was amazing as she was very busy, but she was attentive.

We can't wait to come back and try more food and drink.
reviews.author: Scott

reviews.text:
Definitely suffering from start up pains with respect to the service.  Serving and support staff could benefit from additional training.  Management should walk the floor more to observe the and try to correct the chaos.  Food  delivery times very slow and the chef may be over whelmed or perhaps working with an inexperienced staff.

Dining atmosphere is nice and staff is friendly, albeit a bit incompetent.  Food is good, will give the place another try in a few months to see if they get the service kinks worked out.
reviews.author: Christopher

reviews.text: Such a beautiful restaurant!!! Truely an experience! Service is amazing and the food was great!
reviews.author: Justine

reviews.text: The restaurant is beautiful, the food is absolutely amazing. The service was sub par at best. It could because it’s still new and they are working out the kinks.
reviews.author: Dawn

reviews.text: Oh. My. Goodness!! Incredible! The decor, the service, we had to add an extra person and they were so accommodating! The food was outstanding and remember … don’t leave without trying the wolf bread. Lisa Vanderpump thank you! You never disappoint!!
reviews.author: Terry

reviews.text: We had the best experience here! My sister was visiting and we were able to snag a reservation here. Our server was absolutely lovely with just the perfect amount of humor and professionalism! I wish I remembered her name (Kim maybe?) she was spectacular. Very attentive, coursed everything perfectly, made excellent recommendations and just really hit the mark with every step of service. The salmon was absolutely delicious accompanied by perfectly seasoned veggies. Wings looked almost too cute to eat topped with EDIBLE GOLD! Very bougie, cocktails were all great. We will definitely be back and hopefully will be lucky enough to have our same server again!
reviews.author: Vanna

reviews.text:
For the level of the dining establishment, we were disappointed.
It started when we checked at 12:45 for our 12:45 reservation for our party of three. The man asked if we were there to change our reservation time. Weird question. We told him we were there to eat.
Then he asked if we wanted to sit at the bar. Another weird question. Also, there were plenty of open tables.
Then the hostess brought two menus and took us to a small table for two. Again, there were three of us. When I said there were only two chairs and set-up for two, she said she would get another chair. I told her it was too small for the three of us. She sounded surprised at that (even though we were three adults with her).
The server and the person she was training came to our table. She did tell us they were out of the bread on the appetizer menu, which we wanted to order.
At no time was the service good. We sat there with empty water and tea glasses, and had to wave her over for refills. They left the empty glasses on our table, so we had many empty glasses, which should have been removed each time. To add to those empty glasses, they did not remove the wine glasses we had said we did not need. (Glasses is now being used a lot, but at one time there were 12 empty or unused on our table.) It looked like a joke, and it seemed like they had no experience waiting tables, especially for fine dining.
There were also other examples, and everything led to us having a bad experience.
reviews.author: Shelley

reviews.text: Excellent service, food quality and servers professionalism absolutely amazing.
reviews.author: Victoria

reviews.text: Service was poor. Drink quality poor. Did not sequence out the appetizers and entrees, the very expensive steak came out cold and with the apps.
reviews.author: Braeden

reviews.text: The staff was so so sweet to us and took great care-made sure everything was great and it was! Best burger i’ve ever had without a doubt and i get a burger everywhere i go lol :) Thank you guys!!
reviews.author: sophee

reviews.text: We had the pleasure of celebrating our Christmas day at Wolf with a dinner reservation. It was a gift to my wife and I couldn’t be more thankful for how everything turned out. I believe both of our servers names were Amy and Nicole. They were both so welcoming and even had a little fun with us about the show! They made the experience unforgettable alone, but everything else was just more of a cherry on top.The cheese balls are definitely a must order whenever you visit. We chose to sit in the cocktail lounge area where it was a little less busy, it was definitely a good choice since it was a date night. This is definitely one of our favorite restaurants in the valley and will be back again. For both the service and food. Thank you, Amy and Nicole again you are both unbelievably awesome. If you take anything away from this review, gentlemen you can’t go wrong with this choice for date night.
reviews.author: Mario

reviews.text: I understand they were still an opening phases. But we really did get the Server who didn’t pay attention. She never suggested anything. She just was in order taker, which is kind of disappointing in this type of restaurant. I expect a lot of knowledge. Almost everything was very good. The Seabass was a little on the small size but very good. The tomahawk pork chop very good. I believe my steak was cooked. I ordered a medium rare. It came out the outside very cool very kind of cold. Sent it back a new steak warmer, but medium well tender, but not what I wanted or that I would receive at Wolff. Still love the atmosphere. It was absolutely gorgeous. Drinks were amazing.
reviews.author: Tara

reviews.text:
Went with two others on Christmas Day. Went at 4 pm when they opened so not many people which we loved!!!

The space is so beautiful! The atmosphere is lively and the staff is friendly and very accommodating.

I had the Wolf burger which would have been excellent but it was too salty. The fries were cooked perfectly.
Others had the goat cheese balls and enjoyed and the brisket and prime rib pasta. The meat was almost a pulled pork consistency and they were hoping it would have been pieces of meat.

We had a Pumptini and a wine. Pumptini was nice flavor but light on alcohol.

My bill was $61.00 dollars for my burger and drink with tax and tip. You definitely are paying for the ambiance.

Overall it was a nice experience andI would recommend!
reviews.author: JULIE

reviews.text: Wolf is all things Vanderpump! What an incredible experience. Our waitress was over the top, funny and attentive with seriously the best sense of humor. We tried the famous goat cheese balls, which were everything they have been known for, I had the most incredible risotto, and my fiancé had an incredible fillet. The ambience is so charming, with an absolute mix of cigar lounge and glam! This was an absolute needed experience in old town! Cesar’s Republic is such a gorgeous hotel and the staff is amazing. I’m so glad a restaurant like this can help get it noticed on the map. We loved it so much that we plan to book a tour for a wedding venue for our upcoming 2026 wedding. Thank you again for the great experience. We will definitely be back.

reviews.text: Beautiful, cozy, and delicious food. The views are stunning and the staff very friendly and attentive.

reviews.text: Beautiful décor with stunning chandeliers that set the perfect mood. The cocktails were excellent, the food was delicious, and the service was outstanding from start to finish. An all-around beautiful night at Wolf by Vanderpump—absolutely worth the visit. 🍸✨

(try the filet :)

One word...FABULOUS!!!
From the moment we walked in...not a detail was missed. Great host staff, bar tenders, servers and management. Excellent food, very reasonably priced. AND what a delicious venue...ambiance galore!! This will be a Scottsdale premier hot spot especially with the upcoming planned expansion for overflow.

reviews.text: Everything felt like it was contributing to a curated experience. I think the decor is what really attracted me here, but I’d stay for the food and cocktails.

reviews.text: This was our first time but definitely will not be our last!  We had the best dinner and experience at Wolf. Great people, drinks, service and quality food. The view is beautiful and I just cannot say enough good things about this new restaurant in Scottsdale.

reviews.text: Came here to check out LVP's new place while we were in town. She hits it out of the park. Just had drinks at the bar but the atmosphere is energetic. Breeze, the bartender, is a gem. Very attentive and easy to talk to. Keep her aournd!
reviews.author: Erin

reviews.text: Wonderful experience and a great addition to Scottsdale. Bar staff were all professional and amazing.
reviews.author: Ricky

reviews.text: Food and Service was very good, but the music streaming through the restaurant was incredibly loud, so much so our party of 4 had to ask to be seated outside just so we could have a conversation. It was crazy loud in there.
reviews.author: Krista

reviews.text: Having been to several of the Vanderpump restaurants over the years with my wife, I would have to say that this was our favorite.  The place was busy on a monday night (in and of itself rather unusual in Scottsdale which was a good sign), and, although we were there for our daughters 22nd birthday dinner, we had planned to go to the restaurant at some point - doing so last night was opportunistic and well worth the trip.  The decor and vibe was great - very uniques, creative, and on brand. The food was excellent, surprisingly so because it had just opened and you always expect a bump or two in operations early on, but, nope - food was great (goat cheese balls, caviar & chips, pasta, salmon, burger - all excellent as was the brownie dessert. The drinks were good (pomtini for my daughter, my spirit drink was not a great pour, but thats a minor quibble) as was the complimentary celebratory birthday shot. Service was great, very attentive, engaging and food was served hot.  We will definitely be heading back with friends and enjoying the lounge a bit more, and trying other food options. A great addition to the expanding, quality restaurant scene here in Scottsdale!
reviews.author: David

reviews.text: Sophisticated and elegant vibe. Great view of Camelback Mountain with the windows open the bread with the hot honey butter is a must. We also ordered the Wagyu short rib Bolognese completely fire. My wife got the 8 ounce fillet, which had some sort of glaze on it with a flavor I’ve never experienced in my life absolutely delicious. We took the churros to go and ate them on the way home very yummy. Highly recommend nothing like it in Scottsdale. ￼

reviews.author: Chris

reviews.text:
We came in for a date night, and the manager was truly wonderful. The drinks were great, and their signature bread was amazing.
That said, I didn’t quite understand the policy of not being able to order drinks at the bar because people are eating there. If you’re waiting for a table, you’re required to wait by the hostess, which felt unnecessary. Most restaurants allow guests to enjoy a drink at the bar while others are dining, so this didn’t really make sense to us.
Unfortunately, the food itself was too greasy for our taste. Overall, there were some highlights, but a few things left us a bit confused and disappointed.
reviews.author: Irina

reviews.text:
From the moment we stepped into Wolf, it was clear this restaurant is something special. The atmosphere strikes the perfect balance between chic and comfortable—stylish décor with thoughtful touches that make you feel welcomed from the first second. It’s the kind of place where you instantly know you’re in for a memorable night.

The service was exceptional: warm, attentive, and genuinely enthusiastic without being intrusive. Every staff member seemed to take pride in making our experience seamless and personal, which created such a lovely vibe throughout the evening.

Now, let’s talk the food—absolutely delicious. Each dish we tried felt thoughtfully composed with bold flavors and beautiful presentation. The seasonal ingredients were fresh and vibrant, and the menu showcased a creative flair that set Wolf apart from other new restaurants in the area. From the perfectly seasoned starters to the rich, satisfying entrees, every bite was a delight. And the dessert? Truly the perfect finish—a sweet, elegant note that left us already planning our next visit.
reviews.author: Gabe

reviews.text: The food and drinks were delicious and the decor and views were gorgeous.  Drink service was very slow but I chalked that up to it being opening weekend.  The menus are gigantic in size and difficult to sit with while you wait for them to be taken away, I’d recommend making them smaller especially since the chairs we got were on the smaller side and the table was small for a group of 4 to comfortably put their food along with the decor already on the table.  There was also no merch to buy but it was displayed as if you could buy.  For a brand this well established and people coming for the name that seemed like a huge miss.  Would definitely return though.
reviews.author: Mandy

reviews.text:
We loved the décor and overall atmosphere, and the food was tasty. I do wish there were more gluten-free options available.

The staff, in general, is very young and still gaining experience. At the hostess stand, there was a group ahead of us and two young men behind us. One of the hostesses ended up calling the guests behind us first. Fortunately, we had reservations, so it didn’t impact our seating, but it was a bit confusing—especially since the others were walk-ins.

Our servers were also young and could benefit from additional training. That said, this was opening week, so we’re happy to give some grace. A little more attentiveness would go a long way. I do want to highlight that our server took my celiac disease seriously and went back to the chef multiple times to confirm which items were safe and could be modified. That effort was truly appreciated.

We will definitely return and hope these small issues are ironed out, as the space has great potential and could be an excellent dining experience.
reviews.author: Julie

reviews.text:
An Unforgettable Experience at Wolf
I had the incredible fortune of dining at Wolf during their soft opening and returned for the official opening because the experience was that spectacular. This is destination dining at its finest.
The Setting
We secured what I believe is the restaurant’s best table - perfectly positioned with expansive windows showcasing breathtaking views of Scottsdale Fashion Square and Camelback Mountain as backdrop. Watching the sunset from this vantage point was pure magic.
The Service
Even during soft opening, the professionalism was impeccable. Our server Kelsey was wonderful, Assistant Manager Gil was attentive and welcoming, and the host desk set the tone with genuine warmth. Top-tier service in every way.
The Food
Every dish delivered, and Head Chef Jason has created something special:
∙Chips with Caviar - absolutely divine, a must-order
∙Ceviche - fresh and beautifully executed
∙Tomato Salad - we substituted burrata for goat cheese, equally lovely
∙The Steak - generously sized, cooked to perfection
∙Wolf Potatoes - rich, indulgent, unforgettable
∙Seasonal Vegetables - gorgeous and delicious
∙Cobbler - the perfect finish
Pro Tip
Arrive early or stay after dinner to enjoy the eighth floor Terrace at Caesars. Stunning skyline views with lounge seating - perfect for an aperitif or digestif with no cover charge.
The Verdict
Wolf delivers on every level: ambiance, cuisine, service, and setting. I’ve already returned once and have my third visit planned. Highly recommend for special occasions or when you want something extraordinary.

reviews.text:
we went the first day it was open to public. The staff was ON IT, very attentive and knowledgeable. Bartenders friendly and knew their drinks! Great presentation! We had a drink at the bar then sat at a table. 

The place is gorgeous, nothing like it in the valley. And of course, the views help make it even more special.  In the past the veranda on the 8th was wasted space, now they have a bar up there (connected from WOLF by stairs) so you can sit outside and enjoy drinks too.  It was beautifully decorated for the holidays not sure what they'll do rest of year but it's a perfect place in nice weather to sit out and have a drink! It, and the pool area off WOLF, are all run by WOLF so first class all the way.

Food was delicious. We were recommended the cheese balls and they were awesome.  We were also recommended the shrimp tacos and the shrimp with big and plump and not too over doughy.   We saw lots going by us we want to go back and try.  

Yes it's pricey but it's worth it for that special date!

reviews.text: The decor is stunning - the thought and attention to detail that went into the waterfall and ambiance is absolutely incredible. The food was out of this world. Fried goat cheese balls in their chile honey sauce - perfection. Burger - savory, juicy and well seasoned. The fish and chips were some of THE best we have ever had - the haddock was so tender and flaky, the batter light and crispy without being soaked in oil. Our drinks were fun, bright, and better than anything we’ve tasted before! With all that being said, the star of the show was our waitress - Amy. She went above and beyond, very friendly, professional, and engaging. She is very knowledgeable about the menu and she painted the perfect picture of our food and drink choices before they even reached our table. Our experience tonight left us looking forward to our next visit. Thank you for the wonderful night.
